qe: Who is known as the father of Pharmacy education in India?
qh: भारत में फार्मेसी शिक्षा के जनक के रूप में किसे जाना जाता है?
o: Mahadeva Lal Schroff | महादेव लाल श्रॉफ
e: Prof. M.L. Schroff started pharmacy education in BHU in 1932, marking the beginning of the profession in India.

qe: The 'Indian Pharmacopoeia' (IP) is published by:
qh: 'इंडियन फार्माकोपिया' (IP) किसके द्वारा प्रकाशित किया जाता है?
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare | स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण मंत्रालय
e: The IP is the official document for drug standards in India, published by the Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC).

qe: Which type of glass is also known as 'Borosilicate Glass'?
qh: किस प्रकार के कांच को 'बोरोसिलिकेट ग्लास' के रूप में भी जाना जाता है?
e: Type I glass is highly resistant and suitable for parenteral products. It has a very low coefficient of expansion, so it can be sterilised in an autoclave without cracking.

qe: Which enzyme level is most specifically elevated in 'Acute Pancreatitis'?
qh: 'एक्यूट पैंक्रियाटाइटिस' में किस एंजाइम का स्तर सबसे विशिष्ट रूप से बढ़ जाता है?
o: Serum Amylase and Lipase | सीरम एमाइलेज और लाइपेज
e: Amylase and Lipase are digestive enzymes produced by the pancreas; their high level in blood indicates pancreatic inflammation.

qe: What is the clinical significance of 'Glycosylated Hemoglobin' (HbA1c) test?
qh: 'ग्लाइकोसिलेटेड हीमोग्लोबिन' (HbA1c) परीक्षण का नैदानिक महत्व क्या है?
o: Average blood sugar of last 3 months | पिछले 3 महीनों का औसत शुगर
e: HbA1c provides a long-term picture of blood glucose control, which is vital for managing Diabetes.

qe: Which drug used in TB treatment can cause 'Optic Neuritis' (vision problems)?
qh: टीबी के उपचार में उपयोग की जाने वाली कौन सी दवा 'ऑप्टिक न्यूराइटिस' का कारण बन सकती है?
e: Ethambutol can cause dose-related visual impairment; patients should have regular eye checkups.

qe: Under the NDPS Act 1985, 'Opium' is classified as a:
qh: NDPS अधिनियम 1985 के तहत, 'अफीम' को किस रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
e: Opium and its derivatives are strictly regulated due to high addiction potential. The Act controls its cultivation, possession, transport and sale, and violations attract heavy penalties.

qe: What is the 'Incubation Period' of Plasmodium falciparum (Malaria)?
qh: प्लाज्मोडियम फाल्सीपेरम (मलेरिया) की 'इनक्यूबेशन अवधि' क्या है?
e: It is the time from the mosquito bite to the first appearance of symptoms. For falciparum malaria it is usually 7 to 14 days, after which fever with chills and sweating appears.

qe: In LFT, 'Alkaline Phosphatase' (ALP) levels are highly elevated in:
qh: LFT में, 'एल्कलाइन फॉस्फेट' (ALP) का स्तर किसमें अत्यधिक बढ़ जाता है?
o: Obstructive Jaundice | पित्त नली में रुकावट/पीलिया
e: High ALP is a hallmark of biliary obstruction or bone-related disorders. The enzyme is found in the bile ducts and in bone, so a blockage or a bone disorder raises its level in the blood.

qe: The 'Medical Termination of Pregnancy' (MTP) Act was first passed in:
qh: 'गर्भ का चिकित्सीय समापन' (MTP) अधिनियम पहली बार कब पारित किया गया था?
e: The MTP Act 1971 provides the legal framework for safe and legal abortions in India. The Act lays down who may perform the termination, up to which duration of pregnancy and at what approved place.

qe: Which electrolyte imbalance is common with 'Digoxin' therapy?
qh: 'डिजॉक्सिन' थेरेपी के साथ कौन सा इलेक्ट्रोलाइट असंतुलन सामान्य है?
e: Low potassium levels increase the risk of Digoxin toxicity, leading to heart rhythm problems.

qe: The 'Blood Urea Nitrogen' (BUN) test is primarily used to evaluate:
qh: 'ब्लड यूरिया नाइट्रोजन' (BUN) परीक्षण का उपयोग मुख्य रूप से किसके मूल्यांकन के लिए किया जाता है?
e: BUN measures the amount of nitrogen in the blood that comes from urea, a waste product filtered by the kidneys.

qe: Under the 'Medicinal and Toilet Preparations Act', which substance is strictly regulated?
qh: 'औषधीय और प्रसाधन सामग्री अधिनियम' के तहत, किस पदार्थ को कड़ाई से विनियमित किया गया है?
e: The act regulates the use of alcohol in medicines to prevent its misuse as a beverage. Manufacturers of such preparations need a licence and must keep a record of the alcohol used in each batch.

qe: Which drug is the preferred 'Beta-blocker' for treating Glaucoma?
qh: ग्लूकोमा के इलाज के लिए पसंदीदा 'बीटा-ब्लॉकर' कौन सी दवा है?
e: Timolol eye drops reduce intraocular pressure by decreasing aqueous humor production. It lowers the formation of aqueous humour in the eye, and it must be avoided in asthmatics as it can cause bronchospasm.

qe: The primary goal of 'Palliative Care' is:
qh: 'पेलिएटिव केयर' (Palliative Care) का प्राथमिक लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: Relieving symptoms and improving quality of life | लक्षणों से राहत
e: It is focused on providing relief from pain and stress for patients with serious illnesses.

qe: Which condition is treated with 'Zidovudine' (AZT)?
qh: 'जिडोवुडिन' (AZT) से किस स्थिति का इलाज किया जाता है?
e: AZT is a reverse transcriptase inhibitor used in the management of HIV infection. It is used along with other antiretroviral drugs so that the virus does not become resistant to a single agent.

qe: What is the 'Drug Inspector's' power under Section 22 of the D&C Act?
qh: D&C अधिनियम की धारा 22 के तहत 'ड्रग इंस्पेक्टर' की क्या शक्ति है?
o: To inspect premises and take samples | निरीक्षण और नमूने लेना
e: Inspectors can enter, search, and seize records or samples to ensure legal compliance. The inspector may also lift samples for testing and launch prosecution in the court for a violation.

qe: In pharmacotherapeutics, what is the 'DASH' diet used for?
qh: फार्माकोथेरेप्यूटिक्स में, 'DASH' आहार का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
e: Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) focuses on low sodium and high potassium/calcium.

qe: 'Schedule J' of the D&C Act contains a list of:
qh: D&C अधिनियम के 'शेड्यूल J' में किसकी सूची शामिल है?
o: Incurable diseases | बीमारियाँ जिन्हें ठीक करने का दावा नहीं किया जा सकता
e: It lists diseases that a drug may not claim to prevent or cure (e.g., blindness, cancer). Blindness, cancer, diabetes and heart disease are some of the conditions listed, and no drug may claim to cure them.

qe: Which laboratory parameter is monitored for patients on 'Warfarin' therapy?
qh: 'वारफारिन' थेरेपी ले रहे रोगियों के लिए किस प्रयोगशाला पैरामीटर की निगरानी की जाती है?
e: INR measures how long it takes for blood to clot, ensuring the dose is safe and effective.

qe: What is 'Evidence-Based Medicine' (EBM)?
qh: 'एविडेंस-बेस्ड मेडिसिन' (EBM) क्या है?
o: Using the best current clinical research for patient care | सर्वोत्तम शोध का उपयोग
e: EBM integrates clinical expertise with the best available external clinical evidence. It depends on systematically reviewed evidence such as clinical trials and meta-analyses, and not on opinion alone.

qe: The 'Drugs and Magic Remedies Act' 1954 prohibits:
qh: 'ड्रग्स एंड मैजिक रेमेडीज एक्ट' 1954 क्या प्रतिबंधित करता है?
o: Misleading advertisements of drugs | भ्रामक विज्ञापन
e: It prevents claims of 'magical' cures for diseases like cancer or epilepsy in advertisements.

qe: Which drug is used in the 'Step-1' of asthma management?
qh: अस्थमा प्रबंधन के 'स्टेप-1' में किस दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: SABA like Salbutamol is used for quick relief of asthma symptoms. It relaxes the bronchial muscles within minutes, and inhaled steroids are added when symptoms become frequent.

qe: Which committee in a hospital is responsible for selecting the list of essential drugs?
qh: अस्पताल में आवश्यक दवाओं की सूची चुनने के लिए कौन सी समिति जिम्मेदार है?
e: PTC is responsible for developing the Hospital Formulary and ensuring rational drug use. It also reviews adverse drug reports and lays down policies for safe and rational use of medicines in the hospital.

qe: What is the primary function of a 'Satellite Pharmacy'?
qh: 'सैटेलाइट फार्मेसी' का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
o: Providing pharmacy services closer to patient wards | वार्डों के पास सेवा प्रदान करना
e: Satellite pharmacies are small sub-stations located in specific areas/wards of the hospital for faster drug delivery.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Medication Error' of omission?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी 'ओमिशन' (omission) की दवा त्रुटि है?
o: Failing to administer an ordered dose | आदेशित खुराक देना भूल जाना
e: Omission error occurs when a prescribed dose is not given to the patient at the scheduled time.

qe: What is the full form of 'TNP' in clinical nutrition?
qh: क्लीनिकल पोषण में 'TNP' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
o: Total Parenteral Nutrition | टोटल पैरेंट्रल न्यूट्रिशन
e: TPN is the intravenous feeding of all necessary nutrients to patients who cannot use their digestive tract.

qe: The term 'Inventory Turnover Ratio' indicates:
qh: 'इन्वेंट्री टर्नओवर रेशियो' क्या दर्शाता है?
o: How many times stock is replaced in a year | स्टॉक कितनी बार बदला गया
e: A high ratio suggests efficient inventory management and fast-moving stock. A low ratio points to overstocking or slow-moving items that may expire before they are used.

qe: What is 'Drug-Induced Disease' known as?
qh: 'दवा से होने वाली बीमारी' को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Iatrogenic conditions are those caused by medical treatment or drug side effects. Common examples are drug-induced hepatitis, kidney damage and severe skin rashes.

qe: Which document is used by nurses to record the time of drug administration?
qh: दवाओं के प्रशासन के समय को रिकॉर्ड करने के लिए नर्सों द्वारा किस दस्तावेज़ का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: MAR is a legal document used to track the patient's drug intake in the hospital. The nurse signs the chart after giving each dose, so it also serves as proof of the dose and the exact time.

qe: Which of these is a 'Class A' item in ABC analysis?
qh: ABC विश्लेषण में 'क्लास ए' आइटम कौन सा है?
o: Costly life-saving medicines | महंगी जीवन रक्षक दवाएं
e: Class A items are few in number (10%) but account for 70% of the total budget. Since these items consume most of the budget, they are ordered in small quantities and audited most strictly.

qe: What is 'Clinical Pharmacy'?
qh: 'क्लीनिकल फार्मेसी' क्या है?
o: Practice of pharmacy focused on patient-oriented services | रोगी-केंद्रित सेवा
e: Clinical pharmacists work directly with doctors and patients to optimize drug therapy. It includes taking the drug history, selecting the dose, monitoring the therapy and counselling the patient.

qe: What is the standard temperature for 'Cool Place' storage?
qh: 'ठंडी जगह' (Cool Place) भंडारण के लिए मानक तापमान क्या है?
e: A cool place means a temperature between 8 and 25 degrees Celsius, while a refrigerator is kept at 2 to 8 degrees.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Potassium-Sparing' diuretic?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'पोटेशियम-स्पेयरिंग' मूत्रवर्धक है?
e: Spironolactone inhibits aldosterone, preventing potassium loss while promoting sodium excretion.

qe: What does a high level of 'Serum Bilirubin' indicate?
qh: 'सीरम बिलीरुबिन' का उच्च स्तर क्या दर्शाता है?
e: Bilirubin is a byproduct of RBC breakdown; its accumulation causes yellowing of skin and eyes.

qe: Which drug is used to treat 'Opioid Overdose'?
qh: 'ओपियोइड ओवरडोज़' के इलाज के लिए किस दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Naloxone is an opioid antagonist that rapidly reverses respiratory depression. It is given at once when the breathing rate falls or the pupils become pinpoint, but its effect wears off in a short time.

qe: What is the function of 'Glutathione' in the body?
qh: शरीर में 'ग्लूटाथियोन' का क्या कार्य है?
e: Glutathione protects cells from oxidative stress and helps in the metabolism of toxins. It is a major antioxidant, and its stores fall in liver damage, chronic alcohol use and old age.

qe: The 'Therapeutic Index' of a drug is a measure of its:
qh: किसी दवा का 'चिकित्सीय सूचकांक' (Therapeutic Index) किसका माप है?
e: A higher therapeutic index means the drug is safer, as there is a wide gap between effective and toxic doses.

qe: Presence of 'Albumin' in urine (Albuminuria) suggests damage to:
qh: मूत्र में 'एल्ब्यूमिन' की उपस्थिति किसके खराब होने का संकेत देती है?
o: Glomerular filter of Kidney | किडनी का फिल्टर
e: Normally, large proteins like albumin are not filtered into the urine. The glomerular filter normally holds back large proteins, so their leakage in urine points to damage of the filter.

qe: Which hormone is deficient in 'Diabetes Insipidus'?
qh: 'डायबिटीज इंसिपिडस' में किस हार्मोन की कमी होती है?
e: ADH deficiency leads to the excretion of large volumes of dilute urine. Without it the kidneys cannot concentrate urine, and the patient passes large volumes of dilute urine and feels very thirsty.

qe: What is 'First-pass metabolism'?
qh: 'फर्स्ट-पास मेटाबॉलिज्म' क्या है?
o: Drug metabolism in the liver before reaching systemic circulation | यकृत में चयापचय
e: It significantly reduces the bioavailability of many oral drugs. The drug is first carried by the portal vein to the liver, which destroys a part of it before it reaches the circulation.

qe: Which inorganic element is essential for 'Thyroid' hormone synthesis?
qh: 'थायराइड' हार्मोन संश्लेषण के लिए कौन सा अकार्बनिक तत्व आवश्यक है?
e: Iodine is a key component of T3 and T4 hormones. It is a part of the thyroid hormones T3 and T4, and its deficiency leads to goitre.

qe: Which drug interaction occurs when 'Tetracycline' is taken with milk?
qh: जब 'टेट्रासाइक्लिन' को दूध के साथ लिया जाता है तो कौन सा ड्रग इंटरेक्शन होता है?
o: Reduced absorption due to chelation | अवशोषण में कमी
e: Calcium in milk binds with tetracycline, preventing its absorption in the gut. The insoluble complex is passed out in the stool, so dairy products must be avoided around the dose.

qe: What is the primary role of 'HEPA' filters in hospital pharmacy?
qh: अस्पताल फार्मेसी में 'HEPA' फिल्टर की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
o: Providing sterile air in aseptic areas | स्टेराइल हवा प्रदान करना
e: High-Efficiency Particulate Air (HEPA) filters are used in laminar airflow benches to prepare sterile IV products.

qe: Which element of 'Patient Counseling' involves explaining the frequency of dose?
qh: 'रोगी परामर्श' के किस तत्व में खुराक की आवृत्ति समझाना शामिल है?
o: Instructions for use | उपयोग के निर्देश
e: Counseling ensures the patient understands how and when to take their medication. Clear directions about frequency improve adherence and prevent both missed doses and double dosing.

qe: What does 'ABC Analysis' stand for in inventory management?
qh: इन्वेंट्री प्रबंधन में 'ABC विश्लेषण' का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Always Better Control | ऑलवेज बेटर कंट्रोल
e: It classifies inventory into three categories (A, B, and C) based on their consumption value.

qe: Which condition is characterized by high 'Uric Acid' levels in blood?
qh: रक्त में उच्च 'यूरिक एसिड' स्तर किस स्थिति की विशेषता है?
e: Gout is a type of arthritis caused by the accumulation of urate crystals in joints. The crystals settle in the joints and cause sudden severe pain, most often in the big toe.

qe: The 'Minimum area' required to open a retail pharmacy is:
qh: रिटेल फार्मेसी खोलने के लिए आवश्यक 'न्यूनतम क्षेत्र' है:
e: A minimum area of 10 square meters is required for a retail drug outlet. The premises also need a registered pharmacist, proper storage and a licence from the State Licensing Authority.

qe: What is 'Pharmacovigilance'?
qh: 'फार्माकोविजिलेंस' (Pharmacovigilance) क्या है?
o: Monitoring drug safety and adverse effects | दवा सुरक्षा की निगरानी
e: It is the science of detecting, assessing, and preventing adverse effects of medicines. Health workers report suspected reactions on the ADR form, which is sent to the national monitoring centre for analysis.

qe: Which organization provides 'GPP' (Good Pharmacy Practice) guidelines?
qh: 'GPP' (Good Pharmacy Practice) दिशानिर्देश कौन सा संगठन प्रदान करता है?
e: International Pharmaceutical Federation (FIP) and WHO provide global standards for pharmacy practice.

qe: In hospital pharmacy, 'LVP' stands for:
qh: अस्पताल फार्मेसी में, 'LVP' का अर्थ है:
o: Large Volume Parenterals | लार्ज वॉल्यूम पैरेंट्रल
e: LVPs are sterile products like IV fluids (500ml or more) given to patients. They are used for fluid and electrolyte therapy and must be sterile, particle-free and clearly labelled.

qe: Which drug is used as an 'Antidote' for Paracetamol poisoning?
qh: पैरासिटामोल विषाक्तता के लिए 'एंटीडोट' के रूप में किस दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: N-acetylcysteine restores glutathione levels in the liver to prevent damage. It works best when given within 8 to 10 hours of the overdose, and it restores the glutathione stores of the liver.

qe: What is 'Angina Pectoris'?
qh: 'एंजाइना पेक्टोरिस' (Angina Pectoris) क्या है?
o: Chest pain due to reduced blood flow to heart | सीने में दर्द
e: It is a primary symptom of Ischemic Heart Disease (IHD). It is caused by a temporary shortage of oxygen to the heart muscle, and the pain becomes worse on exertion.

qe: What is the primary site of drug absorption for most oral medications?
qh: अधिकांश मौखिक दवाओं के अवशोषण का प्राथमिक स्थान क्या है?
e: The small intestine has a large surface area (villi), making it ideal for drug absorption.

qe: Which enzyme is deficient in 'Lactose Intolerance'?
qh: 'लैक्टोज इनटोलरेंस' में किस एंजाइम की कमी होती है?
e: Lactase is required to break down lactose (milk sugar) into glucose and galactose. The undigested lactose is fermented by the bacteria in the colon, causing gas, cramps and loose motions after milk.

qe: The Pharmacy Act was passed in India in the year:
qh: भारत में फार्मेसी अधिनियम किस वर्ष पारित किया गया था?
e: The Pharmacy Act 1948 was enacted to regulate the profession of pharmacy in India. It created the Pharmacy Council of India to fix minimum education standards and to maintain a register of pharmacists.

qe: Which drug is used as a 'First-line' treatment for Anaphylactic Shock?
qh: एनाफिलेक्टिक शॉक के लिए 'प्रथम-पंक्ति' उपचार के रूप में किस दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Adrenaline is the drug of choice for acute allergic emergencies (anaphylaxis). It is injected into the outer thigh, and its quick action opens the airways and raises the falling blood pressure.

qe: What is the normal range of 'Blood Glucose' in fasting state?
qh: उपवास की स्थिति में 'ब्लड ग्लूकोज' की सामान्य सीमा क्या है?
e: Fasting blood sugar between 70-110 mg/dL is considered normal for a healthy adult. A fasting value of 126 mg/dL or more on two occasions points to diabetes, while values just above the upper limit are called impaired fasting glucose.

qe: 'Schedule X' of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act includes:
qh: ड्रग्स और कॉस्मेटिक्स एक्ट के 'शेड्यूल X' में शामिल हैं:
o: Narcotics and Psychotropic drugs | नशीली और साइकोट्रोपिक दवाएं
e: Schedule X drugs require special licenses and record-keeping due to their potential for abuse.

qe: Which type of 'Lipoprotein' is known as 'Good Cholesterol'?
qh: किस प्रकार के 'लिपोप्रोटीन' को 'अच्छा कोलेस्ट्रॉल' कहा जाता है?
e: HDL (High-Density Lipoprotein) helps remove cholesterol from the arteries. A high HDL level is protective, while a high LDL favours the deposit of cholesterol plaques in the arteries.

qe: What is 'Polyuria' in clinical pathology?
qh: क्लिनिकल पैथोलॉजी में 'पॉलीयूरिया' (Polyuria) क्या है?
o: Excessive production of urine | मूत्र का अत्यधिक उत्पादन
e: Polyuria is a common symptom of uncontrolled Diabetes Mellitus. It means passing more than about 2.5 to 3 litres of urine in a day, and it is a warning sign of diabetes.

qe: Which schedule deals with 'Life period of drugs'?
qh: दवाओं की 'जीवन अवधि' (Life period) से कौन सा शेड्यूल संबंधित है?
e: Schedule P specifies the expiry periods and storage conditions for various drugs. It lays down the shelf life and the storage conditions, and these details must also be printed on the label.

qe: The term 'Bioavailability' refers to:
qh: 'जैव उपलब्धता' (Bioavailability) का तात्पर्य है:
o: Fraction of drug reaching systemic circulation | रक्तप्रवाह में पहुँचने वाली दवा का अंश
e: Bioavailability is 100% for drugs given by the intravenous (IV) route. Drugs given by mouth show a lower bioavailability because of first-pass metabolism and incomplete absorption.

qe: What is a major consequence of 'Pharmaceuticals' entering water bodies?
qh: 'फार्मास्युटिकल्स' के जल निकायों में प्रवेश करने का एक प्रमुख परिणाम क्या है?
o: Development of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) | एंटीमाइक्रोबियल रेजिस्टेंस (AMR)
e: Traces of antibiotics in water allow bacteria to evolve and become resistant to treatments.

qe: Which gas is the primary contributor to 'Acid Rain'?
qh: 'अम्लीय वर्षा' के लिए प्राथमिक रूप से कौन सी गैस जिम्मेदार है?
o: Sulphur Dioxide (SO2) and Nitrogen Oxides | सल्फर डाइऑक्साइड
e: SO2 and NOx react with water vapor in the atmosphere to form sulfuric and nitric acids. Sulphur dioxide released by burning coal and oil is the main contributor, and nitrogen oxides add to it.

qe: Which disease is directly associated with 'Water Pollution'?
qh: कौन सी बीमारी सीधे 'जल प्रदूषण' से जुड़ी है?
o: Typhoid and Cholera | टाइफाइड और हैजा
e: Contaminated water is the main carrier of pathogens causing enteric diseases. Cholera, typhoid, hepatitis A and diarrhoea are the common diseases that spread through faecally contaminated water.

qe: The 'Decibel' (dB) is a unit used to measure:
qh: 'डेसिबल' (dB) किसकी माप के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली इकाई है?
o: Sound intensity (Noise pollution) | ध्वनि की तीव्रता
e: High decibel levels over time lead to hearing loss and stress-related disorders. It measures the loudness of sound, and continuous exposure above about 85 decibels can damage the inner ear.

qe: How should 'Expired Medicines' be ideally disposed of by a pharmacist?
qh: एक फार्मासिस्ट द्वारा 'पुरानी/एक्सपायर दवाओं' का निपटान आदर्श रूप से कैसे किया जाना चाहिए?
o: Returning to manufacturer or biomedical waste incineration | बायोमेडिकल वेस्ट मैनेजमेंट
e: Correct disposal prevents chemical leaching into the environment and soil. They should be handed over to a pharmacy or take-back centre for safe destruction, never flushed down a drain or thrown in the open.

qe: 'Eutrophication' in lakes is caused by the excess of:
qh: झीलों में 'यूट्रोफिकेशन' (Eutrophication) किसकी अधिकता के कारण होता है?
o: Nitrates and Phosphates (Nutrients) | नाइट्रेट और फास्फेट
e: Excess nutrients lead to algal blooms, which deplete oxygen in the water and kill aquatic life.

qe: What is the health effect of chronic 'Air Pollution'?
qh: पुराने 'वायु प्रदूषण' का स्वास्थ्य पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
o: Respiratory diseases like COPD and Lung Cancer | श्वसन रोग
e: Particulate matter (PM2.5) and toxic gases damage the lungs and cardiovascular system. It raises the risk of asthma, bronchitis and lung cancer, and long exposure also damages the heart.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Biodegradable' waste?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'बायोडिग्रेडेबल' कचरा है?
e: Biodegradable waste can be broken down naturally by microorganisms. Kitchen and garden waste, paper and cotton are examples, and they can be converted into compost.

qe: What is the primary role of a pharmacist in promoting 'Environmental Health'?
qh: 'पर्यावरणीय स्वास्थ्य' को बढ़ावा देने में फार्मासिस्ट की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
o: Educating patients on proper drug disposal | दवाओं के सही निपटान पर शिक्षा
e: Pharmacists can prevent 'Pharmaceutical Pollution' by guiding the public on how to handle unused medicines.

qe: The 'Greenhouse Effect' is mainly responsible for:
qh: 'ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव' मुख्य रूप से किसके लिए जिम्मेदार है?
e: Gases like CO2 trap heat in the atmosphere, leading to a rise in the Earth's average temperature.

qe: Which term describes the number of 'new cases' of a disease in a population during a specific period?
qh: एक विशिष्ट अवधि के दौरान जनसंख्या में बीमारी के 'नए मामलों' की संख्या को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Incidence focuses on the rate of new occurrences, helping to understand the spread of acute diseases.

qe: What is the formula for 'Case Fatality Rate' (CFR)?
qh: 'केस फेटालिटी रेट' (CFR) का सूत्र क्या है?
o: (Total deaths from disease / Total cases of disease) x 100 | (बीमारी से मौतें / बीमारी के कुल मामले) x 100
e: CFR measures the severity of a disease by calculating the percentage of infected people who die.

qe: What is the primary focus of 'Pharmacoeconomics'?
qh: 'फार्माकोइकोनॉमिक्स' का प्राथमिक फोकस क्या है?
o: Cost-benefit and cost-effectiveness of drug therapy | दवा चिकित्सा की लागत और प्रभावशीलता
e: Pharmacoeconomics compares the costs and outcomes of different pharmaceutical products to optimize healthcare spending.

qe: 'Morbidity' in a population refers to:
qh: जनसंख्या में 'रुग्णता' (Morbidity) का तात्पर्य है:
o: State of being diseased or unhealthy | रोगग्रस्त या अस्वस्थ होने की अवस्था
e: Morbidity data tracks the prevalence and incidence of various illnesses in a community. It is expressed as incidence and prevalence rates, and it helps in planning the health services of a district.

qe: The 'Prevalence' rate is calculated as:
qh: 'प्रसार' (Prevalence) दर की गणना कैसे की जाती है?
o: (All existing cases / Total population) x 1000 | (कुल मौजूद मामले / कुल जनसंख्या)
e: Prevalence includes both old and new cases at a specific point in time. Prevalence is the total number of cases, old and new, divided by the total population at that point of time.

qe: Which study in Pharmacoeconomics measures outcomes in 'Quality-Adjusted Life Years' (QALYs)?
qh: फार्माकोइकोनॉमिक्स का कौन सा अध्ययन 'QALYs' में परिणामों को मापता है?
e: Cost-utility analysis considers both the quantity and quality of life gained through treatment.

qe: 'Infant Mortality Rate' (IMR) is the number of deaths of infants under:
qh: 'शिशु मृत्यु दर' (IMR) कितनी उम्र के शिशुओं की मौतों की संख्या है?
e: IMR is calculated per 1000 live births for children below one year of age. It is a sensitive index of the health status and of the mother and child care services of a state or country.

qe: Why is Pharmacoeconomics important for 'National Health Policy'?
qh: 'राष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य नीति' के लिए फार्माकोइकोनॉमिक्स क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है?
o: To decide which medicines should be subsidized/reimbursed | सस्ती दवाओं का चयन करने के लिए
e: It helps the government allocate limited budgets to the most effective treatments. It compares the cost and the outcome of treatments, and helps to fix prices and pick cost-effective essential medicines.

qe: The term 'Endemic' means a disease that:
qh: 'एंडेमिक' (Endemic) शब्द का अर्थ है वह बीमारी जो:
o: Is constantly present in a specific area | किसी विशिष्ट क्षेत्र में निरंतर मौजूद रहती है
e: Endemic diseases are localized and expected within a specific population (e.g., Malaria in some regions).

qe: What is 'Cost-Minimization Analysis' (CMA)?
qh: 'कॉस्ट-मिनिमाइजेशन विश्लेषण' (CMA) क्या है?
o: Comparing two drugs with equal outcomes to find the cheapest | समान परिणामों वाली दवाओं में से सस्ती खोजना
e: CMA is used when two therapies have identical clinical results but different costs. It is the simplest method and compares only the cost of the two options, since the clinical results are the same.

qe: In epidemiology, the term 'Prevalence' refers to:
qh: महामारी विज्ञान में 'प्रसार' (Prevalence) का तात्पर्य है:
o: Total number of existing cases (old + new) | कुल मामलों की संख्या
Only new cases of a disease
e: Prevalence measures the total burden of a disease in a population at a specific point in time.

qe: What is 'Pharmacoeconomics'?
qh: 'फार्माकोइकोनॉमिक्स' (Pharmacoeconomics) क्या है?
o: Description and analysis of the costs of drug therapy | दवा चिकित्सा की लागत और विश्लेषण
e: It helps in identifying the most cost-effective treatment options for public health programs.

qe: Which of the following is an example of 'Psychosocial Pharmacy' issue?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'मनोसामाजिक फार्मेसी' मुद्दे का एक उदाहरण है?
o: Drug misuse and substance abuse | नशीली दवाओं का दुरुपयोग
e: Psychosocial pharmacy deals with the social impact of habits like narcotics, alcohol, and tobacco use.

qe: 'Morbidity' rate measures the:
qh: 'रुग्णता' (Morbidity) दर क्या मापती है?
o: Frequency of illness in a population | जनसंख्या में बीमारी की आवृत्ति
e: Morbidity refers to having a disease or the amount of disease within a population. It measures the proportion of people suffering from a particular illness in a defined population over a given period.

qe: Environmental pollution due to 'Pharmaceuticals' primarily occurs through:
qh: 'फार्मास्युटिकल्स' के कारण पर्यावरणीय प्रदूषण मुख्य रूप से किसके माध्यम से होता है?
o: Improper disposal of expired drugs and excreta | दवाओं का अनुचित निपटान
e: Traces of drugs in water bodies can lead to long-term health hazards and antimicrobial resistance.

qe: What is the primary objective of the 'National Health Policy 2017'?
qh: 'राष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य नीति 2017' का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Attaining the highest possible level of health and well-being | स्वास्थ्य और कल्याण का उच्चतम स्तर प्राप्त करना
e: NHP 2017 focuses on preventive healthcare and making health services affordable. It aims at universal health coverage, higher government spending on health and stronger primary care services.

qe: Which term describes a sudden outbreak of a disease in a large population?
qh: कौन सा शब्द बड़ी आबादी में बीमारी के अचानक प्रकोप का वर्णन करता है?
e: An epidemic occurs when the incidence of a disease exceeds what is normally expected in a population.

qe: 'Noise Pollution' can lead to which health issue?
qh: 'ध्वनि प्रदूषण' से कौन सी स्वास्थ्य समस्या हो सकती है?
o: Hypertension and hearing loss | उच्च रक्तचाप और बहरापन
e: Chronic exposure to loud noise affects cardiovascular health and psychological well-being.

qe: What is 'Millennium Development Goals' (MDGs) focus in health?
qh: स्वास्थ्य में 'मिलेनियम डेवलपमेंट गोल्स' (MDGs) का फोकस क्या है?
o: Reducing child mortality and improving maternal health | बाल मृत्यु दर कम करना
e: MDGs and SDGs (Sustainable Development Goals) are global targets for improving public health outcomes.

qe: A 'Balanced Diet' must contain:
qh: एक 'संतुलित आहार' में होना चाहिए:
o: All essential nutrients in correct proportions | सही अनुपात में सभी आवश्यक पोषक तत्व
e: It provides all the macronutrients and micronutrients needed for the body's optimal function.

qe: Which part of the Nephron is responsible for 'Filtration'?
qh: नेफ्रॉन का कौन सा भाग 'निस्पंदन' (Filtration) के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
e: Blood is filtered in the glomerulus under pressure into Bowman's capsule. The filtrate is like plasma without proteins, and about 180 litres are formed and then almost fully reabsorbed every day.

qe: The hormone 'Testosterone' is produced by:
qh: 'टेस्टोस्टेरोन' हार्मोन किसके द्वारा निर्मित होता है?
e: Testosterone is the primary male sex hormone responsible for secondary sexual characteristics.

qe: What is 'Micturition'?
qh: 'मिक्चुरिशन' (Micturition) क्या है?
o: Process of passing urine | पेशाब करने की प्रक्रिया
e: Micturition is the clinical term for the act of emptying the urinary bladder. It is controlled by the detrusor muscle of the bladder and the sphincters, and it is disturbed in retention and incontinence.

qe: Where does 'Fertilization' of the egg usually occur in females?
qh: महिलाओं में अंडे का 'निषेचन' (Fertilization) आमतौर पर कहाँ होता है?
e: Fertilization occurs when the sperm meets the egg in the fallopian tube. The fertilised egg then travels down the tube to the uterus, where it implants in the wall.

qe: Which structure in the 'Ear' maintains 'Body Balance'?
qh: 'कान' की कौन सी संरचना 'शरीर का संतुलन' बनाए रखती है?
e: The semicircular canals in the inner ear are vital for maintaining equilibrium. These canals are filled with fluid and they signal the position and rotation of the head to the brain.

qe: What is the function of 'Melanin' in the skin?
qh: त्वचा में 'मेलानिन' (Melanin) का क्या कार्य है?
o: Protection against UV radiation | यूवी विकिरण से सुरक्षा
e: Melanin is a pigment that protects the deeper layers of skin from sun damage. It absorbs the ultraviolet rays of the sun and also gives the skin, hair and eyes their colour.

qe: Which hormone triggers 'Ovulation' in the menstrual cycle?
qh: मासिक धर्म चक्र में 'ओव्यूलेशन' को कौन सा हार्मोन ट्रिगर करता है?
e: A surge in LH levels midway through the cycle causes the release of the egg. The surge of luteinising hormone about a day before ovulation makes the mature follicle burst and release the egg.

qe: The 'Olfactory' nerve is associated with which sense?
qh: 'घ्राण' (Olfactory) तंत्रिका किस इंद्रिय से जुड़ी है?
e: The olfactory system is responsible for the sense of smell. The receptor cells in the upper part of the nasal cavity send smell signals straight to the brain.

qe: What is the role of the 'Prostate Gland' in males?
qh: पुरुषों में 'प्रोस्टेट ग्रंथि' की क्या भूमिका है?
o: Secreting fluid that nourishes sperm | वीर्य तरल का स्राव
e: The prostate secretes an alkaline fluid that makes up part of the semen. This milky alkaline fluid protects the sperm, and the enlarged gland causes difficulty in passing urine.

qe: Which part of the 'Tongue' is most sensitive to 'Bitter' taste?
qh: 'जीभ' का कौन सा भाग 'कड़वे' स्वाद के लिए सबसे अधिक संवेदनशील होता है?
e: Different areas of the tongue have specialized receptors for various tastes. Receptors for each taste are spread over the tongue, and bitterness is best sensed at the base.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Water-Soluble' vitamin?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'पानी में घुलनशील' विटामिन है?
e: Vitamins B and C are water-soluble, while A, D, E, and K are fat-soluble. They dissolve in water and are not stored in the body, so they must be taken daily and the excess passes in urine.

qe: What is the recommended dietary allowance (RDA) for 'Iodine' to prevent Goitre?
qh: घेंघा को रोकने के लिए 'आयोडीन' की अनुशंसित दैनिक मात्रा (RDA) क्या है?
e: A very small amount of iodine (approx 150 mcg) is needed daily for thyroid health. Iodised salt is the commonest source, and its deficiency causes goitre and mental retardation in children.

qe: The term 'Pasteurization' is primarily used for:
qh: 'पाश्चुरीकरण' (Pasteurization) शब्द का प्रयोग मुख्य रूप से किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: Sterilizing milk by heating | दूध का स्टरलाइजेशन
e: It is a process of heating liquids to kill harmful microbes without altering the taste. Milk is heated to about 63 degrees for 30 minutes or 72 degrees for 15 seconds and then cooled quickly.

qe: Which mineral deficiency causes 'Anaemia'?
qh: किस खनिज की कमी से 'एनीमिया' (Anaemia) होता है?
e: Iron is a core component of hemoglobin; its lack reduces oxygen transport. Iron forms a part of haemoglobin, and its shortage produces anaemia with weakness, pallor and breathlessness.

qe: What is the causative agent of 'Cholera'?
qh: 'हैजा' (Cholera) का कारक जीव क्या है?
e: Cholera is an acute intestinal infection caused by ingestion of contaminated water. The bacteria multiply in the gut and release a toxin that causes profuse rice-water stools and severe dehydration.

qe: Which test is used for the detection of 'Typhoid'?
qh: 'टाइफाइड' का पता लगाने के लिए किस परीक्षण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: The Widal test detects antibodies against Salmonella typhi. In the test the serum shows agglutination with O and H antigens, and rising titres help to confirm enteric fever.

qe: 'Artificial Ripening' of fruits is often done using:
qh: फलों को 'कृत्रिम रूप से पकाने' के लिए अक्सर किसका उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Calcium carbide releases acetylene gas, which is used for ripening but can be harmful. It is banned in many places because carbide carries traces of arsenic and phosphorus, which are harmful.

qe: What is 'Food Fortification'?
qh: 'फूड फोर्टिफिकेशन' (Food Fortification) क्या है?
o: Adding essential micronutrients to food | भोजन में सूक्ष्म पोषक तत्व मिलाना
e: Fortification increases the nutritional value of food, e.g., adding Iodine to salt. It is used to correct common deficiencies, as in iodised salt, iron-fortified flour and vitamin-A fortified oil.

qe: Which microbe is responsible for 'Chickenpox'?
qh: 'चेचक' (Chickenpox) के लिए कौन सा सूक्ष्मजीव जिम्मेदार है?
o: Varicella Zoster Virus | वेरिसेला जोस्टर वायरस
e: Chickenpox is a highly contagious viral infection. It spreads through droplets and direct contact, and one attack usually gives protection for life.

qe: What is the primary objective of 'Antenatal Care' (ANC)?
qh: 'प्रसवपूर्व देखभाल' (ANC) का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Health of the mother and fetus during pregnancy | गर्भावस्था के दौरान मां और भ्रूण का स्वास्थ्य
e: ANC ensures a safe pregnancy and a healthy delivery for both mother and child. It includes regular check-ups, weight and blood pressure record, tests for anaemia and infection and the tetanus injections.

qe: What is the average 'Cardiac Cycle' duration in a healthy human?
qh: एक स्वस्थ मानव में औसत 'कार्डियक चक्र' (Cardiac Cycle) की अवधि क्या है?
e: The cardiac cycle includes atrial and ventricular contraction and relaxation. At a heart rate of 72 per minute the cycle takes about 0.8 second, and it becomes shorter when the heart beats faster.

qe: Which part of the brain controls 'Respiratory Rate'?
qh: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग 'श्वसन दर' को नियंत्रित करता है?
e: The Medulla Oblongata contains centers for vital functions like respiration and heart rate.

qe: The 'Renin-Angiotensin System' (RAS) primarily regulates:
qh: 'रेनिन-एंजियोटेंसिन सिस्टम' (RAS) मुख्य रूप से किसे नियंत्रित करता है?
o: Blood Pressure and Fluid balance | रक्तचाप और तरल संतुलन
e: RAS is a hormone system within the urinary and CVS systems that regulates long-term blood pressure.

qe: Which cells in the pancreas produce 'Glucagon'?
qh: अग्न्याशय की कौन सी कोशिकाएं 'ग्लूकागन' का उत्पादन करती हैं?
e: Alpha cells produce glucagon to increase blood sugar, while beta cells produce insulin. Glucagon is released when the blood sugar falls, and it acts on the liver to release stored glucose.

qe: What is the role of 'Platelets' in the haemopoietic system?
qh: हीमोपोएटिक प्रणाली में 'प्लेटलेट्स' की क्या भूमिका है?
o: Blood clotting and repair | रक्त का थक्का जमना
e: Platelets or Thrombocytes are vital for preventing blood loss during injury. They stick to the injured vessel, release clotting factors and start the clotting process; a low count causes bruising and bleeding.

qe: Which organ is responsible for the 'Biotransformation' (Metabolism) of most drugs?
qh: अधिकांश दवाओं के 'बायोट्रांसफॉर्मेशन' (चयापचय) के लिए कौन सा अंग जिम्मेदार है?
e: The liver is the primary site for drug metabolism in the human body. The liver converts fat-soluble drugs into more water-soluble forms that the kidneys can easily excrete.

qe: A 'Normal' human blood pressure reading is approximately:
qh: एक 'सामान्य' मानव रक्तचाप रीडिंग लगभग कितनी होती है?
e: Systolic pressure is 120 and diastolic is 80 mmHg in a healthy adult. The upper figure is the systolic pressure during contraction and the lower is the diastolic pressure between the beats.

qe: Which hormone is known as the 'Emergency Hormone'?
qh: किस हार्मोन को 'आपातकालीन हार्मोन' के रूप में जाना जाता है?
e: Adrenaline is released from the adrenal glands during stress or danger ('fight or flight').

qe: What does a 'Peak Flow Meter' measure?
qh: 'पीक फ्लो मीटर' क्या मापता है?
o: Force of air expelled from lungs | फेफड़ों से हवा का वेग
e: It is used to monitor lung function, especially in asthma and COPD patients. A fall in the reading warns of worsening asthma even before the patient feels breathless.

qe: Which structure in the 'Eye' is responsible for adjusting the focus (Accommodation)?
qh: 'आंख' में कौन सी संरचना फोकस (समायोजन) को समायोजित करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
o: Ciliary muscles and Lens | सिलियरी मांसपेशियां और लेंस
e: The ciliary muscles change the shape of the lens to focus on objects at different distances.

qe: What is the incubation period for 'Tuberculosis' (TB)?
qh: 'तपेदिक' (TB) की इनक्यूबेशन अवधि (Incubation period) क्या है?
o: Weeks to months | हफ्तों से महीनों तक
e: TB is a slow-growing bacterial infection, and the onset of symptoms can take several weeks or months after infection.

qe: Which program was launched to eliminate TB in India by 2025?
qh: 2025 तक भारत में टीबी को खत्म करने के लिए कौन सा कार्यक्रम शुरू किया गया था?
e: NTEP aims for the total elimination of TB in India through early diagnosis and treatment. The programme gives free tests, medicines and follow-up, and it uses rapid molecular tests for early detection.

qe: The 'Glycemic Index' (GI) of a food measures:
qh: भोजन का 'ग्लाइसेमिक इंडेक्स' (GI) क्या मापता है?
o: How quickly food increases blood sugar | ब्लड शुगर पर प्रभाव
e: GI is used to counsel diabetic patients on which foods to eat or avoid. Foods with a low index such as whole grains and pulses raise the blood sugar slowly and are preferred in diabetes.

qe: What is the primary role of a pharmacist in 'Disaster Management'?
qh: 'आपदा प्रबंधन' में फार्मासिस्ट की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
o: Stockpiling and distribution of emergency medicines | आपातकालीन दवाओं का वितरण
e: Pharmacists ensure the availability of essential medicines and first aid during natural or man-made disasters.

qe: Which vitamin is crucial for 'Blood Clotting'?
qh: 'रक्त का थक्का जमने' के लिए कौन सा विटामिन महत्वपूर्ण है?
e: Vitamin K is essential for the synthesis of clotting factors in the liver. It is a fat-soluble vitamin, and its deficiency causes prolonged bleeding, so newborns are given an injection of it at birth.

qe: 'FSSAI' regulations primarily deal with:
qh: 'FSSAI' नियम मुख्य रूप से किससे संबंधित हैं?
o: Food safety, storage, and labeling | खाद्य सुरक्षा और लेबलिंग
e: FSSAI ensures the quality and safety of food products and supplements. It issues licences to food businesses and fixes the limits for additives, contaminants and labelling.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Macronutrient'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'मैक्रोन्यूट्रिएंट' (Macronutrient) है?
e: Proteins, carbohydrates, and fats are needed in large quantities and provide energy. Carbohydrates and proteins give about 4 kilocalories per gram, while fats give about 9, so they are the main energy sources.

qe: The WHO definition of health includes which three dimensions?
qh: स्वास्थ्य की WHO परिभाषा में कौन से तीन आयाम शामिल हैं?
o: Physical, mental, and social | शारीरिक, मानसिक और सामाजिक
e: Health is a state of complete physical, mental, and social well-being. The definition goes beyond the mere absence of disease, and it forms the base of the primary health care approach.

qe: Which minerals are routinely included in 'Oral Rehydration Therapy' (ORT)?
qh: 'ओरल रीहाइड्रेशन थेरेपी' (ORT) में कौन से खनिज शामिल होते हैं?
e: ORT restores electrolyte balance lost during dehydration. A simple ORS packet contains sodium chloride, potassium chloride, sodium citrate and glucose, dissolved in one litre of clean water.

qe: The primary cause of 'Goitre' (enlargement of thyroid) is:
qh: 'घेंघा' (Goitre) का प्राथमिक कारण क्या है?
e: Iodine is essential for thyroid hormone production; its deficiency leads to Goitre. The gland enlarges in an attempt to trap more iodine, and the use of iodised salt is the simplest way to prevent it.

qe: What is 'Herbal Drug Interaction'?
qh: 'हर्बल ड्रग इंटरैक्शन' (Herbal Drug Interaction) क्या है?
o: Interaction between an herb and a modern synthetic drug | जड़ी-बूटी और आधुनिक दवा के बीच प्रतिक्रिया
e: It refers to the clinical significance of taking herbal medicines along with conventional drugs.

qe: Which herb is well-known for interacting with 'Warfarin' and increasing the risk of bleeding?
qh: कौन सी जड़ी-बूटी 'वारफारिन' के साथ प्रतिक्रिया करने और रक्तस्राव के जोखिम को बढ़ाने के लिए जानी जाती है?
o: Garlic (Lehsun) and Ginkgo | लहसुन और जिन्कगो
e: Garlic and Ginkgo have anti-platelet effects that can dangerously enhance the effect of blood thinners.

qe: The process of 'Phytochemical Investigation' starts with which step?
qh: 'फाइटोकेमिकल जांच' की प्रक्रिया किस चरण से शुरू होती है?
e: Extraction is the first step to separate active phytoconstituents from the plant matrix. The extract is then put through qualitative chemical tests and chromatography, and finally the pure compounds are isolated.

qe: Which extraction method uses a 'Soxhlet Apparatus' for continuous hot extraction?
qh: निरंतर गर्म निष्कर्षण के लिए किस विधि में 'सॉक्सलेट उपकरण' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Successive Solvent Extraction | क्रमिक विलायक निष्कर्षण
e: Soxhlet extraction is a standard phytochemical process for exhausting a drug of its active constituents.

qe: St. John's Wort (an herb) is famous for reducing the effectiveness of 'Oral Contraceptives' due to:
qh: सेंट जॉन्स वोर्ट 'ओरल कॉन्ट्रासेप्टिव्स' की प्रभावशीलता को कम करने के लिए प्रसिद्ध है क्योंकि:
o: Induction of Liver enzymes (CYP3A4) | लिवर एंजाइमों का प्रेरण
e: This herb speeds up the metabolism of many modern drugs, making them less effective. It induces the cytochrome P450 enzymes of the liver, so drugs such as contraceptives, warfarin and cyclosporine are broken down faster and fail.

qe: What is the primary purpose of 'Phytochemical Screening'?
qh: 'फाइटोकेमिकल स्क्रीनिंग' का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To detect the presence of alkaloids, glycosides, etc. | सक्रिय घटकों की उपस्थिति का पता लगाना
e: Screening involves chemical tests to identify the classes of compounds present in an extract.

qe: Which solvent is considered a 'Universal Solvent' for extracting a wide range of phytoconstituents?
qh: फाइटोकांस्टिट्यूएंट्स की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला निकालने के लिए किस विलायक को 'यूनिवर्सल सॉल्वेंट' माना जाता है?
e: Alcoholic solvents are effective for extracting both polar and some non-polar compounds. Ethanol dissolves most alkaloids, glycosides, resins and volatile oils, and dilute alcohol is used as a hydroalcoholic mixture.

qe: Taking 'Digoxin' with 'Senna' can lead to:
qh: 'डिजॉक्सिन' को 'सेना' के साथ लेने से क्या हो सकता है?
o: Potassium depletion and heart toxicity | पोटेशियम की कमी और हृदय विषाक्तता
e: Laxatives like Senna can lower potassium levels, which increases the risk of Digoxin toxicity.

qe: What is 'Decoction' in phytochemical investigation?
qh: फाइटोकेमिकल जांच में 'डेकोक्शन' (Decoction) क्या है?
o: Boiling the drug in water | पानी में उबालना
e: Decoction involves boiling hard plant parts like bark or roots in water to extract constituents.

qe: Which analytical technique is commonly used to 'separate' individual compounds from an extract?
qh: अर्क (extract) से व्यक्तिगत यौगिकों को 'अलग' करने के लिए आमतौर पर किस तकनीक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Chromatography is essential for the isolation and investigation of pure phytoconstituents.

qe: Which 'Plant fibre' is primarily used as a surgical dressing due to its high absorbency?
qh: किस 'पादप फाइबर' का उपयोग इसकी उच्च अवशोषण क्षमता के कारण सर्जिकल ड्रेसिंग के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Cotton is processed to remove wax, making it 'absorbent' for surgical use. The wax is removed by scouring, so the fibre can take up water, antiseptics and discharges readily.

qe: What is the biological source of 'Silk'?
qh: 'रेशम' (Silk) का जैविक स्रोत क्या है?
e: Silk is a natural protein fibre obtained from the cocoons of the silkworm. It is secreted by the larva of the silk moth Bombyx mori while it spins its cocoon, and it is a protein fibre like wool.

qe: 'Surgical Catgut' is classified as:
qh: 'सर्जिकल कैटगट' (Surgical Catgut) को किस रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
e: Catgut is an absorbable suture prepared from the intestines of sheep or cattle. It is made from the submucosa of sheep intestine and is digested by the body enzymes, so the stitches need not be removed.

qe: What is the primary protein found in 'Wool'?
qh: 'ऊन' (Wool) में पाया जाने वाला प्राथमिक प्रोटीन क्या है?
e: Wool is a natural animal fibre composed mainly of the protein keratin. The fibre is crimped, elastic and warm, and lanolin, the fat obtained from wool, is also used in ointments.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Non-absorbable' natural suture?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'गैर-शोषक' (Non-absorbable) प्राकृतिक सूत्र है?
e: Silk and cotton are examples of non-absorbable sutures that must be removed manually. Such sutures hold the tissues for a long time and have to be removed once the wound has healed.

qe: 'Kangaroo Tendon' is an example of which category?
qh: 'कंगारू टेंडन' किस श्रेणी का उदाहरण है?
e: It is a specialized natural absorbable suture used in specific surgeries. It is obtained from the tendon of the kangaroo and is a natural suture material used in certain operations.

qe: What is a 'Ligature' used for in surgery?
qh: सर्जरी में 'लिगेचर' (Ligature) का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: Tying off blood vessels to stop bleeding | रक्त वाहिकाओं को बांधना
e: Ligatures are threads used specifically for tying blood vessels. It is tied tightly round the vessel to stop bleeding or to close a duct during the operation.

qe: Which treatment is given to Catgut to delay its absorption time in the body?
qh: शरीर में कैटगट के अवशोषण समय में देरी के लिए उसे क्या उपचार दिया जाता है?
e: Chromic catgut is treated with chromium salts to resist digestion by body enzymes. The chromium salt treatment delays the action of the digestive enzymes, so the suture holds the tissue for a much longer time.

qe: The fibre 'Wool' is obtained from the fleece of:
qh: 'ऊन' (Wool) फाइबर किसके ऊन (fleece) से प्राप्त होता है?
e: Wool is the natural animal fibre derived from sheep. The fleece is sheared from the animal once a year, and the fibre is then cleaned to remove grease and dirt.

qe: Which surgical dressing is used as a 'filtering medium' and to provide support to fractured limbs (as plaster)?
qh: किस सर्जिकल ड्रेसिंग का उपयोग 'फ़िल्टरिंग माध्यम' और अंगों को सहारा देने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Cotton and Gauze | कपास और धुंध (Gauze)
e: Cotton and its derivatives are fundamental in providing mechanical support and protection to wounds.

qe: Which chemical test is used for the identification of 'Alkaloids'?
qh: 'अल्कलॉइड्स' की पहचान के लिए किस रासायनिक परीक्षण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Mayer's, Wagner's, and Dragendorff's tests are standard identification tests for alkaloids.

qe: In the microscopy of 'Senna' leaves, which diagnostic feature is observed?
qh: 'सेना' की पत्तियों की माइक्रोस्कोपी में कौन सी नैदानिक विशेषता देखी जाती है?
o: Paracytic stomata and unicellular trichomes | पैरासिटिक स्टोमेटा
e: Paracytic stomata are a key anatomical characteristic of Senna leaves. The leaf also shows mucilage cells and calcium oxalate crystals, which help to identify the drug in powder form.

qe: 'Borntrager's Test' is specifically used to identify:
qh: 'बोर्नट्रेजर परीक्षण' विशेष रूप से किसकी पहचान के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: It produces a pink to red color in the ammoniacal layer for glycosides. The powder is shaken with ether and ammonia, and a pink to red colour in the lower ammoniacal layer shows anthraquinone glycosides such as those of Senna.

qe: Which microscopic feature is characteristic of 'Clove' (flower bud)?
qh: 'लौंग' (पुष्प कली) की कौन सी सूक्ष्म विशेषता विशिष्ट है?
o: Schizolysigenous oil glands | तेल ग्रंथियां (Oil glands)
e: Clove contains large oil glands containing eugenol. The oil is distilled from the dried buds, which also show sclereids and calcium oxalate crystals.

qe: The 'Goldbeater's skin test' is used for the identification of:
qh: 'गोल्डबीटर स्किन टेस्ट' किसकी पहचान के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Tannins have the ability to bind with proteins, which is the basis of this test. The strip of goldbeater's skin and a ferrous salt give a brown or black colour, showing that the tannins have combined with the protein.

qe: In the T.S. of 'Cinnamon' bark, which of these is absent?
qh: 'दालचीनी' की छाल के T.S. में इनमें से क्या अनुपस्थित होता है?
e: Cinnamon is a 'channeled' bark where the cork and cortex are usually removed. In true cinnamon the cork and cortex are scraped off, so mainly the phloem with its sclereids remains.

qe: Which reagent gives a red precipitate with alkaloids in 'Dragendorff's Test'?
qh: 'ड्रैगडॉर्फ परीक्षण' में अल्कलॉइड के साथ कौन सा अभिकर्मक लाल अवक्षेप देता है?
o: Potassium Bismuth Iodide | पोटेशियम बिस्मथ आयोडाइड
e: Dragendorff's reagent is a solution of potassium bismuth iodide. An orange to reddish-brown precipitate shows the presence of alkaloids, and the reagent is also used as a spray reagent on chromatograms.

qe: 'Keller-Killiani Test' is used to detect:
qh: 'केलर-किलियानी परीक्षण' किसके पता लगाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Deoxy sugars in Cardiac Glycosides | कार्डिएक ग्लाइकोसाइड्स
e: This test is specific for the digitoxose sugar found in Digitalis. The test is done with ferric chloride in acetic acid and sulphuric acid, and a blue ring in the lower layer shows cardiac glycosides.

qe: The presence of 'Lignified phloem fibres' is a diagnostic feature of which bark?
qh: 'लिग्निफाइड फ्लोएम फाइबर' की उपस्थिति किस छाल की नैदानिक विशेषता है?
e: Large, spindle-shaped lignified fibres are characteristic of Cinchona bark. Cinchona bark is the source of quinine, and it is identified by thick-walled lignified fibres along with calcium oxalate prisms.

qe: Which test is used for 'Saponin' glycosides based on their ability to cause hemolysis?
qh: 'सैपोनिन' ग्लाइकोसाइड्स के लिए उनकी हेमोलिसिस करने की क्षमता के आधार पर कौन सा परीक्षण उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Saponins cause foam when shaken with water and also cause hemolysis of RBCs. The name comes from sapo, or soap, and saponins are also used as emulsifiers and as fish poisons.

qe: Which 'Herbal oil' is commonly used for promoting hair growth and in cosmetics?
qh: बालों के विकास और कॉस्मेटिक्स में आमतौर पर किस 'हर्बल तेल' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Almond oil is a common ingredient in herbal hair and skin cosmetics. It is rich in vitamin E, and it also acts as a soothing base for massage and skin preparations.

qe: What is the role of 'Omega-3-fatty acids' in health food?
qh: स्वास्थ्य भोजन (health food) में 'ओमेगा-3-फैटी एसिड' की क्या भूमिका है?
o: Cardiovascular health / Brain function | हृदय स्वास्थ्य
e: Omega-3 acids are essential nutraceuticals for heart and brain health. Fish oil and flaxseed oil are rich sources, and they help to lower blood cholesterol and protect the heart and brain.

qe: Which plant is known as 'Holy Basil' and used for its antiseptic and immunity-boosting properties?
qh: किस पौधे को 'पवित्र तुलसी' के रूप में जाना जाता है?
e: Tulsi is a miscellaneous crude drug with broad therapeutic applications. The leaves are also used for cold, cough and fever, and the plant is grown in almost every Indian home.

qe: In Pharmacognosy, 'Organoleptic evaluation' refers to evaluation by:
qh: फार्माकोग्नॉसी में, 'ऑर्गेनोलेप्टिक मूल्यांकन' का तात्पर्य किसके द्वारा मूल्यांकन से है?
o: Sensory organs (Color, Odour, Taste) | इंद्रियों द्वारा
e: Organoleptic evaluation uses sight, smell, and taste to identify crude drugs. It is a quick and inexpensive first examination in which the colour, odour, taste, texture and fracture of the drug are noted.

qe: What is 'Spirulina' categorized as?
qh: 'स्पाइरुलिना' (Spirulina) को किस रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
e: Spirulina is a nutrient-rich blue-green algae used as a dietary supplement. It is rich in protein, vitamins and minerals and is used as a nutraceutical and in the diet of malnourished children.

qe: Which herbal formulation is prepared through the 'Nitration' or 'Calcinations' process in Ayurveda?
qh: आयुर्वेद में 'कैलसिनेशन' प्रक्रिया के माध्यम से कौन सा हर्बल फॉर्मूलेशन तैयार किया जाता है?
e: Bhasmas are fine powders prepared by the process of incineration or calcination. The metals and minerals are repeatedly heated with herbal juices to give a fine, tasteless and easily absorbable powder.

qe: Which oil is derived from 'Sandalwood' and used in perfumes and cosmetics?
qh: 'चंदन' (Sandalwood) से प्राप्त होने वाला कौन सा तेल इत्र और सौंदर्य प्रसाधनों में उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Sandalwood oil is highly valued for its fragrance and cosmetic properties. The oil is distilled from the heartwood of Santalum album, and it is used both in perfumes and as a cooling agent for the skin.

qe: 'Dietary fibres' are important in the diet for:
qh: आहार में 'आहार फाइबर' किसके लिए महत्वपूर्ण हैं?
o: Digestive health and preventing constipation | पाचन स्वास्थ्य
e: Fibers like Ispaghula help in maintaining bowel regularity. Fibres add bulk to the stool, help it to pass easily and also bind some cholesterol and sugar in the intestine.

qe: Which crude drug is used as a 'Cardiotonic' besides Digitalis?
qh: डिजिटलिस के अलावा किस क्रूड ड्रग का उपयोग 'कार्डियोटोनिक' के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Terminalia arjuna bark is used as a cardiotonic in traditional medicine. The bark also has a mild diuretic and blood-pressure lowering effect and is used as a tonic for the heart.

qe: Adulteration of crude drugs means:
qh: क्रूड ड्रग्स की 'मिलावट' (Adulteration) का अर्थ है:
o: Debasement or substitution with inferior substances | घटिया पदार्थों के साथ मिलावट
e: Adulteration involves replacing the genuine drug with inferior or exhausted material. It occurs when the drug is scarce and costly, and it can be dangerous if a wrong or toxic plant is substituted.

qe: What is the biological source of 'Digitalis', a potent cardiotonic drug?
qh: एक शक्तिशाली कार्डियोटोनिक दवा, 'डिजिटलिस' का जैविक स्रोत क्या है?
e: Digitalis purpurea leaves contain glycosides used to treat congestive heart failure. The active glycosides are digitoxin and gitoxin, and the drug is used cautiously because of its narrow margin of safety.

qe: Which phytoconstituent is primarily responsible for the 'Antimalarial' activity of Cinchona?
qh: सिंकोना (Cinchona) की 'एंटी-मलेरियल' गतिविधि के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा फाइटोकांस्टिट्यूएंट जिम्मेदार है?
e: Quinine is an alkaloid derived from Cinchona bark used in malaria treatment. The bark contains quinine and related alkaloids which kill the malaria parasite present in the blood.

qe: 'Rauwolfia serpentina' (Sarpagandha) is clinically used as an:
qh: 'रौवोल्फिया सर्पेंटिना' (सर्पगंधा) का नैदानिक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है:
e: Rauwolfia is famous for its alkaloid reserpine which lowers blood pressure. The drug also has a sedative effect, and reserpine acts by depleting the nerve endings of their noradrenaline stores.

qe: Which drug is used as an 'Anti-rheumatic' in the herbal drug category?
qh: हर्बल ड्रग श्रेणी में 'एंटी-रूमेटिक' के रूप में किस दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Colchicum contains colchicine, which is used in the treatment of gout and rheumatism. Colchicine relieves acute attacks of gout by reducing the inflammation of the joints.

qe: What are the primary chemical constituents of 'Aloe'?
qh: 'एलो' (Aloe) के प्राथमिक रासायनिक घटक क्या हैं?
e: Aloin and barbaloin are the active principles in Aloe used as laxatives. These anthraquinone glycosides act on the large intestine, and the dried juice of the leaves is the commercial drug.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Pharmaceutical Aid' derived from seaweed?
qh: समुद्री शैवाल (seaweed) से प्राप्त होने वाला 'फार्मास्युटिकल एड' कौन सा है?
e: Agar is a polysaccharide obtained from red algae used as a gelling agent. It gels in water and is used as a suspending agent, an emulsifier and as a culture medium in the laboratory.

qe: The therapeutic efficacy of 'Vasaka' is primarily as an:
qh: 'वासाका' (Vasaka) की चिकित्सीय प्रभावकारिता मुख्य रूप से है:
e: Adhatoda vasica (Vasaka) is widely used for respiratory ailments and cough. The leaf contains the alkaloid vasicine, which thins the sputum and also dilates the bronchi.

qe: Which enzyme is obtained from 'Papaya'?
qh: 'पपीता' से कौन सा एंजाइम प्राप्त होता है?
e: Papain is a proteolytic enzyme derived from the latex of Carica papaya. It digests proteins, and it is used to tenderise meat, to clear turbid liquids and in the treatment of wounds and worms.

qe: What is the biological source of 'Ashwagandha'?
qh: 'अश्वगंधा' (Ashwagandha) का जैविक स्रोत क्या है?
e: Withania somnifera is used as a rejuvenating tonic and adaptogen. The root is used as a tonic and adaptogen to improve strength and to help the body cope with stress.

qe: Which drug is used as an 'Anti-dysenteric'?
qh: 'एंटी-डिसेंट्रिक' (Anti-dysenteric) के रूप में किस दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Ipecac root is used to treat amoebic dysentery. Emetine, an alkaloid of its root, acts on Entamoeba histolytica, and the drug was once also used to induce vomiting.

qe: The term 'Ayurveda' literally means:
qh: 'आयुर्वेद' शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है?
o: Science of Life | जीवन का विज्ञान
e: Ayurveda is an ancient Indian system focusing on balanced living and herbal medicine. The name comes from ayus, meaning life, and veda, meaning knowledge, and the tradition is more than two thousand years old.

qe: Which traditional system of medicine is based on the principle 'Similia Similibus Curentur'?
qh: चिकित्सा की कौन सी पारंपरिक प्रणाली 'सिमिलिया सिमिलिबस क्यूरेंटुर' के सिद्धांत पर आधारित है?
e: Homeopathy believes that 'like cures like'. It was founded by Samuel Hahnemann, and its medicines are given in extremely diluted forms.

qe: Which of these is a typical 'Ayurvedic formulation'?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा एक विशिष्ट 'आयुर्वेदिक फॉर्मूलेशन' है?
e: Asava and Arista are fermented liquid preparations in Ayurveda. These self-generated alcoholic preparations keep for a long time, and they may also be prepared by boiling the juice of herbs.

qe: What is the primary use of 'Aloe vera gel' in herbal cosmetics?
qh: हर्बल कॉस्मेटिक्स में 'एलोवेरा जेल' का प्राथमिक उपयोग क्या है?
o: As a skin moisturizer and healing agent | त्वचा मॉइस्चराइज़र के रूप में
e: Aloe vera is widely used for its soothing and cosmetic properties. The gel is applied to burns, wounds and dry skin, and it forms a protective, moisturising film.

qe: 'Almond oil' (Badam oil) is categorized as:
qh: 'बादाम तेल' (Badam oil) को किस रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Fixed oil/Herbal cosmetic source | हर्बल कॉस्मेटिक स्रोत
e: Almond oil is used in various commercial herbal preparations and cosmetics. It is a fixed oil obtained from the seeds, and it is used both as a food and as a cosmetic ingredient.

qe: The active chemical constituents of 'Senna' are:
qh: 'सेना' के सक्रिय रासायनिक घटक क्या हैं?
e: Sennosides are the key phytoconstituents responsible for the laxative effect. They are anthraquinone glycosides that act on the colon and produce a soft stool within eight to twelve hours.

qe: Which 'Herbal oil' is famous for its use in aromatherapy and as a cosmetic for its fragrance?
qh: कौन सा 'हर्बल तेल' अपनी सुगंध के लिए अरोमाथेरेपी और कॉस्मेटिक के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Lavender oil is a popular herbal cosmetic and aromatherapy oil. Its pleasant smell makes it popular in bathing oils and soaps, and it is also used for relaxation.

qe: Which system of medicine originated in Greece but was developed by Arabs?
qh: चिकित्सा की कौन सी प्रणाली ग्रीस (यूनान) में उत्पन्न हुई लेकिन अरबों द्वारा विकसित की गई थी?
e: The Unani system is based on the teachings of Hippocrates and Galen. It is based on the balance of four humours, and it reached India during the medieval period.

qe: What are 'Nutraceuticals'?
qh: 'न्यूट्रस्युटिकल्स' (Nutraceuticals) क्या हैं?
o: Food products with health/medicinal benefits | स्वास्थ्य लाभ वाले खाद्य उत्पाद
e: Nutraceuticals like Spirulina and Garlic provide both nutrition and health benefits. They are also called functional foods, and their use has grown because they may help to prevent chronic disease.

qe: 'Turmeric' (Haldi) is used as an:
qh: 'हल्दी' (Turmeric) का उपयोग किसके रूप में किया जाता है?
o: Antiseptic and disinfectant | एंटीसेप्टिक और कीटाणुनाशक
e: Curcuma longa (Turmeric) has significant antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. Its active constituent curcumin acts as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, and it is also used as a colouring agent.

qe: Which classification of crude drugs organizes them based on their plant kingdom hierarchy (Family, Genus, Species)?
qh: क्रूड ड्रग्स का कौन सा वर्गीकरण उन्हें पादप साम्राज्य पदानुक्रम (कुल, वंश, प्रजाति) के आधार पर व्यवस्थित करता है?
e: Taxonomical classification is based on the botanical or zoological position of the drug. It shows the natural relationship between drugs and helps in their correct identification and study of their families.

qe: In the 'Chemical' classification, drugs are grouped according to their:
qh: 'रासायनिक' वर्गीकरण में, दवाओं को किसके अनुसार समूहीकृत किया जाता है?
e: Chemical classification groups drugs based on their primary chemical constituents like alkaloids or glycosides.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Laxative' drug of natural origin?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी प्राकृतिक मूल की 'लेक्सेटिव' (Laxative) दवा है?
e: Senna contains glycosides that act as a stimulant laxative. Senna contains a resin and acts as a stimulant purgative, so it is not given when the intestine is obstructed.

qe: The biological source of 'Arjuna', a cardiotonic drug, is:
qh: एक कार्डियोटोनिक दवा, 'अर्जुन' का जैविक स्रोत क्या है?
e: Terminalia arjuna is used primarily for its heart-strengthening properties. It is used as a heart tonic, and it also has a mild diuretic and blood-pressure lowering action.

qe: Which category of drugs is used to expel gas from the gastrointestinal tract?
qh: जठरांत्र संबंधी मार्ग से गैस निकालने के लिए किस श्रेणी की दवाओं का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Carminatives like Coriander and Ginger help in relieving flatulence. They work by relaxing the smooth muscle of the gut, and examples are coriander, ginger, cardamom and clove.

qe: What is the primary therapeutic activity of 'Vinca'?
qh: 'विंका' (Vinca) की प्राथमिक चिकित्सीय गतिविधि क्या है?
e: Vinca contains alkaloids like vincristine and vinblastine used in cancer treatment. The alkaloids arrest cell division, and they are used in leukaemia, lymphoma and some other cancers.

qe: Which plant drug acts as an 'Antidiabetic'?
qh: कौन सी पादप-औषधि 'एंटी-डायबिटिक' के रूप में कार्य करती है?
e: Gymnema sylvestre is known for its blood sugar-lowering properties. Its leaf contains gymnemic acid, which reduces the absorption of sugar from the gut and may also stimulate the pancreas.

qe: Which part of the 'Clove' plant is used medicinally?
qh: 'लौंग' (Clove) के पौधे का कौन सा भाग औषधीय रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Dried flower bud | सूखी फूलों की कली
e: Clove is a carminative and GI regulator derived from the flower bud. The dried bud is distilled for its oil, and the oil contains eugenol, which is antiseptic and relieves toothache.

qe: Which of these is a 'Drug acting on the nervous system' derived from natural resources?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा प्राकृतिक संसाधनों से प्राप्त 'तंत्रिका तंत्र पर कार्य करने वाली दवा' है?
e: Opium acts as a potent analgesic on the central nervous system. Opium is the dried latex of the poppy capsules, and its alkaloids morphine and codeine are used to relieve pain.

qe: 'Black Catechu' and 'Pale Catechu' belong to which therapeutic category?
qh: 'ब्लैक कटेचु' और 'पेल कटेचु' किस चिकित्सीय श्रेणी से संबंधित हैं?
e: Astringents are substances that cause contraction of tissues and stop bleeding. Catechu is obtained from Acacia catechu, and it contains tannins which stop bleeding and tone the tissues.

qe: In the assay of 'Ferrous Sulphate' by redox titration, which indicator is used?
qh: रेडॉक्स टाइट्रेशन द्वारा 'फेरस सल्फेट' के परख में किस संकेतक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Potassium permanganate acts as a self-indicator in the redox titration of ferrous salts. The permanganate solution is pink, and the end point is a permanent light pink colour in the flask.

qe: Which heterocyclic system is present in 'Salbutamol*'?
qh: 'साल्बुटामोल*' में कौन सा हेट्रोसाइक्लिक सिस्टम मौजूद है?
o: None (It is an amino alcohol) | कोई नहीं (यह अमीनो अल्कोहल है)
e: Salbutamol is a phenylethanolamine derivative and does not contain a typical heterocyclic ring.

qe: What is the primary pharmacological use of 'Cisplatin*'?
qh: 'सिस्प्लैटिन*' का प्राथमिक फार्माकोलॉजिकल उपयोग क्या है?
e: Cisplatin is an inorganic platinum-based complex used for cancer treatment. It is a platinum coordination complex used in testicular, ovarian and other solid tumours, and it is given by injection.

qe: The term 'Accuracy' in pharmaceutical analysis means:
qh: फार्मास्युटिकल विश्लेषण में 'सटीकता' (Accuracy) शब्द का अर्थ है:
o: Closeness to the true value | वास्तविक मूल्य के करीब होना
e: Accuracy measures how close the experimental value is to the accepted true value. It is expressed as the error or difference from the true value and is checked with a standard sample of known purity.

qe: Which drug is synthesized using the 'Alkalimetry' principle in practicals?
qh: प्रैक्टिकल में किस दवा का विश्लेषण 'अल्केलीमेट्री' सिद्धांत का उपयोग करके किया जाता है?
e: Ibuprofen assay is typically performed using alkalimetry titration. Ibuprofen is an acid, so it is titrated with a standard alkali and the end point is found with an indicator or by potentiometry.

qe: What is the chemical class of 'Chlorpromazine Hydrochloride*'?
qh: 'क्लोरप्रोमेज़ीन हाइड्रोक्लोराइड*' का रासायनिक वर्ग क्या है?
e: Chlorpromazine is the prototype of the phenothiazine antipsychotics. It is used in schizophrenia and in severe vomiting, and it acts by blocking dopamine in the brain.

qe: In the limit test for 'Arsenic', which apparatus is used?
qh: 'आर्सेनिक' के लिमिट टेस्ट में किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: The Gutzeit test is a standard method for arsenic limit testing in pharmaceuticals. In the test the arsenic is turned into arsine gas, which stains mercuric chloride paper; the stain is compared with a standard stain.

qe: Which reagent is used for the assay of 'Ascorbic Acid' (Vitamin C)?
qh: 'एस्कॉर्बिक एसिड' (विटामिन सी) के परख के लिए किस अभिकर्मक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Iodometry is the standard volumetric method for the assay of Ascorbic acid. Vitamin C reduces iodine, and the unused iodine is titrated back with sodium thiosulphate using starch as the indicator.

qe: The chemical name of 'Paracetamol*' is:
qh: 'पैरासिटामोल*' का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
e: Paracetamol is also known as Acetaminophen, an important analgesic-antipyretic. Its chemical name is N-acetyl-para-aminophenol, and it acts as an analgesic and antipyretic.

qe: Why is 'Glycerine' added in the assay of Boric Acid?
qh: बोरिक एसिड के परख (Assay) में 'ग्लिसरीन' क्यों मिलाया जाता है?
o: To increase the acidity of Boric acid | बोरिक एसिड की अम्लता बढ़ाने के लिए
e: Boric acid is a very weak acid; glycerine reacts with it to form a strong complex acid that can be titrated with NaOH.

qe: Which drug is a 'Direct Acting' Sympathomimetic agent?
qh: कौन सी दवा 'डायरेक्ट एक्टिंग' सिम्पैथोमिमेटिक एजेंट है?
e: Epinephrine acts directly on adrenergic receptors. It combines with the adrenergic receptors itself, while the indirect acting drugs work by releasing noradrenaline from the nerves.

qe: What is the medical use of 'Propranolol'?
qh: 'प्रोप्रानोलोल' का चिकित्सा उपयोग क्या है?
o: Beta Adrenergic Blocker for Hypertension | उच्च रक्तचाप के लिए बीटा ब्लॉकर
e: Propranolol is a non-selective beta-blocker used for CVS disorders. It is used in hypertension, angina, arrhythmias, migraine and anxiety, and it is avoided in asthma.

qe: Which drug is used to treat 'Myasthenia Gravis' by inhibiting Cholinesterase?
qh: कोलिनेस्टरेज़ को रोककर 'मायस्थेनिया ग्रेविस' के इलाज के लिए किस दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Neostigmine is a cholinesterase inhibitor that improves muscle strength. It raises the amount of acetylcholine at the neuromuscular junction, which improves the muscle power.

qe: 'Atropine Sulphate' belongs to which category?
qh: 'एट्रोपिन सल्फेट' किस श्रेणी से संबंधित है?
o: Cholinergic Blocking Agent (Anticholinergic) | कोलिनेर्जिक ब्लॉकिंग एजेंट
e: Atropine is a common cholinergic blocking agent used to reduce secretions. It blocks the muscarinic receptors, so it dries the secretions and also dilates the pupil and raises the pulse.

qe: Which drug is an 'Anti-Arrhythmic' agent?
qh: कौन सी दवा 'एंटी-अरिथमिक' (Anti-Arrhythmic) एजेंट है?
e: Quinidine is used to manage abnormal heart rhythms. It belongs to class I of the anti-arrhythmic drugs and slows the conduction of impulses in the heart.

qe: What is the primary use of 'Nitroglycerin' (Isosorbide Dinitrate)?
qh: 'नाइट्रोग्लिसरीन' (आइसोसोरबाइड डिनिट्रेट) का प्राथमिक उपयोग क्या है?
e: Isosorbide dinitrate is used to treat angina pectoris (chest pain). It relaxes the blood vessels, which reduces the load on the heart and relieves the chest pain within a few minutes.

qe: Which drug is a 'Sulphonamide' anti-infective agent?
qh: कौन सी दवा 'सल्फोनामाइड' एंटी-इंफेक्टिव एजेंट है?
e: Sulfamethoxazole is a common sulphonamide often combined with trimethoprim. The combination blocks two steps in the bacterial folic acid pathway, which makes it more effective than either drug alone.

qe: 'Amphotericin-B' is used to treat which type of infection?
qh: 'एम्फोटेरिसिन-बी' का उपयोग किस प्रकार के संक्रमण के इलाज के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Amphotericin-B is a potent antifungal agent. It binds to the ergosterol of the fungal cell membrane, and it is used in serious systemic fungal infections.

qe: Which antiviral agent is markable for 'Acyclovir'?
qh: 'एसिक्लोविर' (Acyclovir) के लिए कौन सा एंटीवायरल एजेंट मार्क करने योग्य है?
o: Antiviral for Herpes | हर्पीस के लिए एंटीवायरल
e: Acyclovir is a key antiviral agent used mainly against herpes and varicella-zoster viruses.

qe: What is the medicinal use of 'Cyclophosphamide'?
qh: 'साइक्लोफॉस्फेमाइड' का औषधीय उपयोग क्या है?
e: Cyclophosphamide is a common chemotherapy drug for cancer treatment. It is an alkylating agent that damages the DNA of rapidly dividing cells, and it is used in leukaemia and lymphoma.

qe: What is the primary medicinal use of 'Boric Acid' as a topical agent?
qh: एक टॉपीकल एजेंट के रूप में 'बोरिक एसिड' का प्राथमिक औषधीय उपयोग क्या है?
o: As a mild anti-infective/antiseptic | हल्के एंटी-इंफेक्टिव के रूप में
e: Boric acid is used topically as a weak antiseptic for eyes and skin infections. It is also used in ear drops and eye lotions, but it must never be taken internally because it is toxic.

qe: In nomenclature, which heterocycle is found in 'Phenobarbital'?
qh: नामकरण में, 'फेनोबार्बिटल' में कौन सा हेट्रोसाइकिल पाया जाता है?
e: Phenobarbital is a barbiturate derivative containing a pyrimidine nucleus. The barbituric acid nucleus is the base of other sedatives as well, such as phenobarbitone and thiopental.

qe: Which inorganic compound is used as a 'Denture Cleaner'?
qh: कौन सा अकार्बनिक यौगिक 'डेंचर क्लीनर' (Denture Cleaner) के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Sodium Perborate/Sodium Carbonate | सोडियम कार्बोनेट मिश्रण
e: Dental products like mouth washes and denture cleaners use oxidizing or alkaline agents. They act by releasing oxygen or by their alkaline action, which loosens the food particles and stains.

qe: What is the medicinal use of 'Magaldrate' in the GI tract?
qh: जठरांत्र संबंधी मार्ग (GI tract) में 'मगाल्ड्रेट' का औषधीय उपयोग क्या है?
o: As an antacid | एंटासिड के रूप में
e: Magaldrate is a common gastro-intestinal agent used as an antacid to neutralize stomach acid.

qe: Which drug is used as a 'General Anaesthetic' through intravenous route?
qh: नस के माध्यम से 'सामान्य एनेस्थेटिक' के रूप में किस दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Thiopental Sodium is an ultra-short-acting barbiturate used for general anaesthesia. It acts within seconds and is used for the induction of anaesthesia, and the patient recovers quickly.

qe: What is the category of 'Amitriptyline Hydrochloride'?
qh: 'एमिट्रिप्टिलाइन हाइड्रोक्लोराइड' की श्रेणी क्या है?
e: Amitriptyline is a tricyclic anti-depressant acting on the central nervous system. It is given at night because it causes drowsiness, and it is also used in some chronic painful conditions.

qe: 'Haloperidol' belongs to which pharmacological class?
qh: 'हैलोपेरिडोल' किस फार्माकोलॉजिकल वर्ग से संबंधित है?
e: Haloperidol is used to treat schizophrenia and other psychiatric conditions. It blocks the dopamine receptors of the brain and is also used in severe agitation and in tic disorders.

qe: Which drug is categorized as an 'Antidepressant' that belongs to the SSRI class?
qh: कौन सी दवा SSRI वर्ग से संबंधित है जिसे 'एंटीडिप्रेसेंट' के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
e: Fluoxetine is a Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitor (SSRI) used for depression. It raises the level of serotonin in the brain and is also used in obsessive-compulsive disorder and bulimia.

qe: 'Vigabatrin' and 'Gabapentin' are used for:
qh: 'विगाबाट्रिन' और 'गाबापेंटिन' का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
e: These medicinal compounds are acting on the CNS to manage seizures. They raise the level of GABA or reduce the release of excitatory transmitters, and they also help in some kinds of nerve pain.

qe: What is the storage condition for most light-sensitive inorganic pharmaceuticals?
qh: अधिकांश प्रकाश-संवेदनशील अकार्बनिक फार्मास्युटिकल्स के लिए भंडारण की स्थिति क्या है?
e: Stability and storage conditions matter for every medicinal compound, because heat, light, moisture and oxygen can slowly degrade it.

qe: Which drug is used as an 'Anticonvulsant' to treat Epilepsy?
qh: मिर्गी के इलाज के लिए 'एंटी-कन्वल्सेंट' के रूप में किस दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Phenytoin is a major anticonvulsant used for generalized tonic-clonic seizures. It blocks the sodium channels in the nerve cells and can be given by injection in status epilepticus.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Loop Diuretic'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'लूप मूत्रवर्धक' (Loop Diuretic) है?
e: Frusemide is a potent diuretic acting on the loop of Henle. It acts on the ascending limb of the loop of Henle, so it removes large amounts of water and sodium, and it is used in oedema and heart failure.

qe: The drug 'Paracetamol' belongs to which category?
qh: 'पैरासिटामोल' दवा किस श्रेणी से संबंधित है?
o: Analgesic and Antipyretic | एनाल्जेसिक और एंटीपायरेटिक
e: Paracetamol is used to relieve pain (analgesic) and reduce fever (antipyretic). It is gentler on the stomach than aspirin, but an overdose damages the liver.

qe: Which of these is used as a 'Sedative and Hypnotic'?
qh: इनमें से किसका उपयोग 'सेडेटिव और हिप्नोटिक' के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Diazepam is a benzodiazepine used for anxiety, sedation, and sleep induction. It also relaxes the muscles and controls convulsions, and it is a controlled drug because of its abuse potential.

qe: The drug 'Metformin' is used to treat which condition?
qh: 'मेटफॉर्मिन' दवा का उपयोग किस स्थिति के इलाज के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Metformin is a first-line oral hypoglycemic agent for diabetes. It is used in type-2 diabetes and lowers blood sugar without causing weight gain, and it is taken with food.

qe: Which category does 'Atenolol' belong to?
qh: 'एटेनोलोल' किस श्रेणी से संबंधित है?
e: Atenolol is a cardio-selective beta-blocker used for hypertension and angina. It slows the heart and lowers the blood pressure, and being cardio-selective it is safer in patients with chest problems.

qe: Which antibiotic is a 'Macrolide'?
qh: कौन सा एंटीबायोटिक 'मैक्रोलाइड' (Macrolide) है?
e: Azithromycin and Erythromycin are examples of macrolide antibiotics. They stop bacterial protein synthesis and are used in respiratory, skin and some atypical infections.

qe: Which drug is an 'Antipsychotic'?
qh: कौन सी दवा 'एंटी-साइकोटिक' (Antipsychotic) है?
e: Chlorpromazine is used to manage schizophrenia and other psychotic disorders. It is also used in severe vomiting and hiccough, and long use can cause extra-pyramidal side effects.

qe: What is the medicinal use of 'Salbutamol' (Albuterol)?
qh: 'साल्बुटामोल' का औषधीय उपयोग क्या है?
e: Salbutamol is a sympathomimetic used to relieve bronchospasm in asthma. It acts on the beta-2 receptors of the bronchi and is given by inhaler or nebuliser during an asthma attack.

qe: 'Isoniazid' (INH) is primarily used for the treatment of:
qh: 'आइसोनियाज़िड' (INH) मुख्य रूप से किसके उपचार के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: INH is a key first-line anti-tubercular drug. It is used along with rifampicin and other drugs in tuberculosis, and pyridoxine is often given with it to prevent numb feet.
