qe: What is the primary objective of a 'Limit Test' in Pharmaceutical Chemistry?
qh: फार्मास्युटिकल केमिस्ट्री में 'लिमिट टेस्ट' का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To control and identify small quantities of impurities | अशुद्धियों को नियंत्रित करना
e: Limit tests are semi-quantitative tests designed to identify and control small amounts of impurities like chloride, sulphate, and iron.

qe: Which reagent is used in the limit test for 'Iron'?
qh: 'आयरन' के लिमिट टेस्ट में किस अभिकर्मक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Thioglycolic acid reacts with iron in the presence of ammonia to produce a pale pink to deep reddish-purple color.

qe: In volumetric analysis, what is 'Standardization'?
qh: वॉल्यूमेट्रिक विश्लेषण में 'मानकीकरण' (Standardization) क्या है?
o: Determining the exact strength of a solution | समाधान की सटीक शक्ति निर्धारित करना
e: Standardization is the process of finding the exact concentration of a solution using a primary standard.

qe: Which type of titration is used for the assay of 'Calcium Gluconate'?
qh: 'कैल्शियम ग्लूकोनेट' के परख (Assay) के लिए किस प्रकार के टाइट्रेशन का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Complexometric titration using EDTA is the standard method for calcium estimation. The calcium ions form a stable complex with EDTA, and an indicator shows the end point by changing colour.

qe: Which of the following is a common 'Antacid' used as a Gastro-intestinal agent?
qh: गैस्ट्रो-इंटेस्टाइनल एजेंट के रूप में उपयोग किया जाने वाला सामान्य 'एंटासिड' कौन सा है?
o: Aluminium Hydroxide Gel | एल्युमिनियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड जेल
e: Aluminium hydroxide gel is a non-systemic antacid used to neutralize gastric acidity. It neutralises the acid without being absorbed and it also constipates, so it is often combined with a magnesium salt.

qe: What is the medicinal use of 'Ferrous Sulphate'?
qh: 'फेरस सल्फेट' का औषधीय उपयोग क्या है?
o: As a Haematinic (to treat Anaemia) | हेमेटिनिक के रूप में
e: Ferrous sulphate is used as a haematinic to treat iron-deficiency anaemia. It supplies iron for the formation of haemoglobin, and it is given with vitamin C to improve its absorption.

qe: Which inorganic compound is used as a 'Topical Agent' for its antiseptic properties?
qh: किस अकार्बनिक यौगिक का उपयोग इसके एंटीसेप्टिक गुणों के लिए 'टॉपीकल एजेंट' के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Hydrogen peroxide is a common topical anti-infective and antiseptic. It releases oxygen on the skin, which cleans the wound, and it is also used as a mouth wash.

qe: In dental products, 'Sodium Fluoride' is primarily used to:
qh: दंत उत्पादों में, 'सोडियम फ्लोराइड' का मुख्य रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है:
o: Prevent dental caries | दंत क्षय (कैविटी) को रोकना
e: Sodium fluoride is an anti-caries agent that strengthens tooth enamel. It makes the enamel resistant to decay, and it is used in toothpastes, mouth washes and drinking water.

qe: Which gas is used as an 'Inhalation Anaesthetic'?
qh: 'सांस के साथ लिए जाने वाले एनेस्थेटिक' के रूप में किस गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Nitrous oxide is a common medicinal gas used for general anaesthesia. It is given along with oxygen and is also used as laughing gas in dentistry and to relieve labour pain.

qe: What is the source of 'Impurities' in pharmaceuticals?
qh: फार्मास्युटिकल्स में 'अशुद्धियों' का स्रोत क्या है?
o: All of the above | उपरोक्त सभी
Manufacturing process and storage | कच्चा माल और निर्माण प्रक्रिया
e: Impurities can come from raw materials, reagents, chemical processes, and storage conditions.

qe: What is the primary objective of 'Quality Assurance' (QA) in a pharmaceutical plant?
qh: फार्मास्युटिकल प्लांट में 'क्वालिटी एश्योरेंस' (QA) का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To prevent defects through systematic processes | व्यवस्थित प्रक्रियाओं के माध्यम से दोषों को रोकना
e: QA is a broad concept that covers all matters that individually or collectively influence the quality of a product.

qe: The process of proving that an 'instrument' provides accurate results within specified limits is called:
qh: यह साबित करने की प्रक्रिया कि एक 'उपकरण' निर्दिष्ट सीमाओं के भीतर सटीक परिणाम देता है, कहलाती है:
e: Calibration is the comparison of a measurement device against a known standard to ensure accuracy.

qe: 'Validation' provides documented evidence that a specific 'process' will:
qh: 'वैलिडेशन' (Validation) दस्तावेजी प्रमाण प्रदान करता है कि एक विशिष्ट 'प्रक्रिया':
o: Consistently produce a product meeting its specifications | लगातार गुणवत्तापूर्ण उत्पाद तैयार करेगी
e: Validation is the documented act of proving that any procedure, process, or activity actually leads to the expected results.

qe: Which of the following is a key requirement for a 'Pharmaceutical Plant Layout'?
qh: 'फार्मास्युटिकल प्लांट लेआउट' के लिए एक प्रमुख आवश्यकता क्या है?
o: Uni-directional flow of materials and personnel | सामग्री और कर्मियों का एक-दिशीय प्रवाह
e: A good layout prevents cross-contamination and mix-ups by ensuring a logical flow of production stages.

qe: Novel Drug Delivery Systems (NDDS) are designed to overcome which challenge?
qh: नोवल ड्रग डिलीवरी सिस्टम (NDDS) को किस चुनौती को दूर करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है?
o: Frequent dosing and side effects | बार-बार खुराक और दुष्प्रभाव
e: NDDS aims to deliver the drug at a controlled rate to a specific site, improving patient compliance.

qe: Which of these is a major 'Challenge' of NDDS?
qh: इनमें से कौन NDDS की एक प्रमुख 'चुनौती' (Challenge) है?
o: High cost and complex formulation technology | उच्च लागत और जटिल तकनीक
e: NDDS requires advanced technology, high investment, and complex scale-up processes. Manufacturing must also give the same release rate from every batch, which is difficult to prove.

qe: What is an example of a 'Targeted' Drug Delivery System?
qh: 'लक्षित' (Targeted) ड्रग डिलीवरी सिस्टम का एक उदाहरण क्या है?
o: Liposomes for cancer therapy | कैंसर चिकित्सा के लिए लिपोसोम्स
e: Liposomes can be engineered to deliver drugs specifically to tumor cells, reducing damage to healthy tissues.

qe: A 'Transdermal Patch' is categorized as:
qh: एक 'ट्रांसडर्मल पैच' को किस श्रेणी में रखा गया है?
o: Novel Drug Delivery System (NDDS) | नोवल ड्रग डिलीवरी सिस्टम
e: Transdermal patches provide controlled drug release through the skin into the bloodstream over a long period.

qe: Which area in a pharmaceutical plant requires the highest level of 'Aseptic' control?
qh: फार्मास्युटिकल प्लांट के किस क्षेत्र में 'एसेप्टिक' नियंत्रण के उच्चतम स्तर की आवश्यकता होती है?
o: Sterile filling area | स्टेराइल फिलिंग क्षेत्र
e: Sterile areas where injectables or eye drops are filled must be free from any microbial contamination.

qe: The 'Design Qualification' (DQ) is a part of:
qh: 'डिज़ाइन क्वालिफिकेशन' (DQ) किसका हिस्सा है?
o: Validation of equipment | उपकरणों का वैलिडेशन
e: Validation includes various stages like DQ, IQ (Installation), OQ (Operational), and PQ (Performance).

qe: What is the main goal of 'Sustained-release' (SR) tablets?
qh: 'सस्टेंड-रिलीज' (SR) टैबलेट का मुख्य लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: Slow and prolonged drug release | धीमी और लंबी अवधि तक दवा रिलीज
e: SR tablets release the drug over a long period to maintain a constant blood concentration.

qe: How do 'Fast-dissolving' (Melt-in-mouth) tablets work?
qh: 'फास्ट-डिज़ॉल्विंग' टैबलेट कैसे कार्य करती हैं?
o: Disintegrate within seconds in the mouth | मुंह में सेकंड के भीतर घुलना
e: They use highly soluble excipients or 'super-disintegrants' for rapid dissolution without water.

qe: Which technology is often used to create 'Extended-release' (ER) systems?
qh: 'एक्सटेंडेड-रिलीज' (ER) सिस्टम बनाने के लिए अक्सर किस तकनीक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Polymer coating or Matrix systems | पॉलिमर कोटिंग या मैट्रिक्स सिस्टम
e: Hydrophilic or hydrophobic polymers are used to control the diffusion rate of the drug. The polymer forms a gel or a shell that releases the drug slowly, so the dose can be given once or twice a day.

qe: In the pharmaceutical plant, 'Calibration' refers to:
qh: फार्मास्युटिकल प्लांट में, 'कैलिब्रेशन' (Calibration) का तात्पर्य है:
o: Checking instrument accuracy against a standard | मानक के विरुद्ध सटीकता की जांच
e: Calibration ensures that weighing scales and equipment provide accurate readings. Instruments are checked against a standard of known value at fixed intervals and the readings are recorded.

qe: What is 'Validation' in the context of cGMP?
qh: cGMP के संदर्भ में 'वैलिडेशन' (Validation) क्या है?
o: Documented proof that a process is consistent | प्रक्रिया की निरंतरता का दस्तावेजी प्रमाण
e: Validation provides a high degree of assurance that a process will consistently produce a quality product.

qe: Which excipient is known as a 'Super-disintegrant' in fast-dissolving tablets?
qh: फास्ट-डिज़ॉल्विंग टैबलेट में किस 'एक्सिपिएंट' को 'सुपर-डििसंटीग्रेंट' के रूप में जाना जाता है?
e: Super-disintegrants swell or wick water rapidly to break the tablet apart in seconds. They swell or draw water into the tablet, which breaks it into small pieces for quick dissolution.

qe: The layout of a pharmaceutical plant must follow:
qh: फार्मास्युटिकल प्लांट का लेआउट किसका पालन करना चाहिए?
o: Schedule M (cGMP) guidelines | शेड्यूल एम (cGMP) दिशानिर्देश
e: Schedule M of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act specifies the requirements for factory premises.

qe: What is 'Novel Drug Delivery System' (NDDS) advantage?
qh: NDDS का क्या लाभ है?
o: Better patient compliance and reduced toxicity | बेहतर रोगी अनुपालन
e: NDDS aims to deliver drugs to a specific site or at a specific rate to reduce side effects.

qe: A 'Matrix Tablet' is an example of which delivery system?
qh: 'मैट्रिक्स टैबलेट' किस डिलीवरी सिस्टम का उदाहरण है?
o: Sustained / Controlled release | सस्टेंड / कंट्रोल्ड रिलीज
e: The drug is evenly dispersed in a polymer matrix that slows down its release. The release depends on the type and amount of the polymer, and the tablet is made by compression.

qe: Why is 'Quality Assurance' (QA) broader than 'Quality Control' (QC)?
qh: QA, QC से अधिक व्यापक क्यों है?
o: QA covers the entire system to prevent errors | QA पूरी प्रणाली को कवर करता है
e: QA is proactive and involves the whole process, while QC is reactive and involves testing the product.

qe: Which edition of the Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP) is the latest as of 2022-2024?
qh: 2022-2024 तक भारतीय फार्माकोपिया (IP) का कौन सा संस्करण नवीनतम है?
e: The 9th edition of IP was published in 2022, containing more than 3100 monographs. It contains monographs for modern as well as some traditional medicines and is revised every few years.

qe: What is a salient feature of the IP 2022 regarding 'Biologicals'?
qh: IP 2022 की 'बायोलॉजिकल' के संबंध में एक मुख्य विशेषता क्या है?
o: Inclusion of Phytopharmaceuticals & 3 new vaccines | फाइटोफार्मास्युटिकल्स और नई वैक्सीन का समावेश
e: IP 2022 introduced standards for phytopharmaceuticals and added several new monographs for vaccines and herbal products.

qe: The 'Double Cone Blender' is primarily used for:
qh: 'डबल कोन ब्लेंडर' मुख्य रूप से किसके लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Dry powder blending | सूखे पाउडर का मिश्रण
e: Double cone blenders are used for uniform mixing of dry powders and granules through tumbling motion.

qe: Which mixer is used to produce extremely fine 'Emulsions' and 'Homogenization'?
qh: बेहद बारीक 'इमल्शन' और 'होमोजेनाइजेशन' बनाने के लिए किस मिक्सर का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Silverson mixer homogenizer | सिल्वरसन मिक्सर होमोजेनाइज़र
e: Silverson homogenizer uses high-speed shearing to break droplets into micron sizes. Its rotor and stator shear the globules so finely that the emulsion does not separate for a long time.

qe: What is the primary role of the 'Triple Roller Mill' in semi-solid manufacturing?
qh: सेमी-सॉलिड निर्माण में 'ट्रिपल रोलर मिल' की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
o: Uniform distribution of solids in ointments | मलहम में ठोस पदार्थों का समान वितरण
e: Triple roller mill provides high shear to remove aggregates and ensure smoothness in ointments.

qe: What is the key technical difference between 'Membrane Filter' and 'Sintered Glass Filter'?
qh: 'मेम्ब्रेन फिल्टर' और 'सिंटर्ड ग्लास फिल्टर' के बीच प्रमुख तकनीकी अंतर क्या है?
o: Disposable vs Reusable | डिस्पोजेबल बनाम पुन: प्रयोज्य
e: Membrane filters are usually disposable (single-use), while sintered glass filters are reusable and chemically inert.

qe: Which filter is preferred for 'Cold Sterilization' of heat-sensitive solutions?
qh: ताप-संवेदनशील समाधानों के 'कोल्ड स्टरलाइजेशन' के लिए कौन सा फिल्टर पसंद किया जाता है?
e: Membrane filters with 0.22-micron pores effectively remove all bacteria from solutions. The solution is forced through the filter into a sterile container, and the work is done in a laminar air flow unit.

qe: In a 'Triple Roller Mill', the rollers rotate at:
qh: 'ट्रिपल रोलर मिल' में, रोलर्स किस गति पर घूमते हैं?
e: Rollers rotate at different speeds to create shear force for effective mixing and size reduction.

qe: The term 'Sintering' in glass filters refers to:
qh: ग्लास फिल्टर में 'सिंटरिंग' (Sintering) शब्द का तात्पर्य है:
o: Fusing glass particles without melting them | कांच के कणों को बिना पिघलाए जोड़ना
e: Sintering creates a porous structure that allows liquids to pass while trapping solids. The glass powder is heated till the particles stick together, and the pore size decides what is held back.

qe: Which IP edition introduced the 'Orange Book' concept for drug safety?
qh: किस IP संस्करण ने दवा सुरक्षा के लिए 'ऑरेंज बुक' अवधारणा पेश की?
e: Recent editions of IP have focused heavily on drug safety, pharmacovigilance, and biosimilars.

qe: Which type of tablet is designed to dissolve under the tongue?
qh: किस प्रकार की टैबलेट को जीभ के नीचे घुलने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है?
e: Sublingual tablets provide rapid drug absorption directly into the systemic circulation. The drug is absorbed from the veins under the tongue and escapes the liver; nitroglycerin is a common example.

qe: Soft gelatin capsules are manufactured using:
qh: सॉफ्ट जिलेटिन कैप्सूल का निर्माण किसका उपयोग करके किया जाता है?
o: Rotary Die Process | रोटरी डाई प्रोसेस
e: Softgels are typically produced using a continuous rotary die encapsulation process. A thin ribbon of gelatine is formed, and the drug is sealed between two sheets by the rotating dies.

qe: Which preparation is a clear, sweetened, hydro-alcoholic liquid oral?
qh: कौन सी प्रिपरेशन एक स्पष्ट, मीठा, हाइड्रो-अल्कोहलिक तरल मौखिक है?
e: Elixirs contain alcohol to help dissolve ingredients that are not water-soluble. They are used as flavoured vehicles for potent drugs, and their alcohol content is usually 5 to 10 per cent.

qe: Enteric-coated tablets are designed to release the drug in the:
qh: 'एन्टरिक-कोटेड' टैबलेट को दवा छोड़ने के लिए कहाँ डिज़ाइन किया गया है?
e: Enteric coating prevents the tablet from dissolving in the acidic environment of the stomach.

qe: What is the role of a 'Humectant' in topical preparations like creams?
qh: क्रीम जैसे टॉपीकल प्रिपरेशंस में 'ह्यूमेक्टेंट' (Humectant) की क्या भूमिका है?
o: To prevent drying out of the product | उत्पाद को सूखने से रोकना
e: Humectants like glycerin retain moisture in the formulation. Glycerin, propylene glycol and sorbitol are common humectants, and they keep the cream smooth and stop it drying.

qe: A 'Toxoid' is used to provide:
qh: 'टॉक्सोइड' (Toxoid) का उपयोग क्या प्रदान करने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Active immunity against toxins | विषाक्त पदार्थों के खिलाफ सक्रिय प्रतिरक्षा
e: Toxoids are inactivated toxins used as vaccines to stimulate the immune system. It gives active immunisation, as in tetanus and diphtheria vaccines, and the body then forms its own antibodies.

qe: In pharmaceutical plants, 'Quality Control' (QC) primarily focuses on:
qh: फार्मास्युटिकल संयंत्रों में, 'क्वालिटी कंट्रोल' (QC) मुख्य रूप से किस पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है?
o: Testing of raw materials and finished products | परीक्षण
e: QC involves the sampling, specifications, and testing of materials to ensure quality. It also covers stability studies and the testing of the finished product before it is released for sale.

qe: Which NDDS provides drug release at a constant rate over a long period?
qh: कौन सा NDDS लंबे समय तक एक स्थिर दर पर दवा रिलीज प्रदान करता है?
e: Modified release tablets reduce the frequency of dosing and maintain steady drug levels. Such systems are called zero-order release systems, and they keep the drug level in the blood steady for hours or days.

qe: The term 'Sera' (Antisera) contains:
qh: 'सीरा' (Antisera) में क्या होता है?
e: Antisera provide immediate passive immunity by delivering pre-formed antibodies. They are given to a person already exposed to tetanus, snake bite or rabies to give quick protection.

qe: Which formulation is specifically used for 'Insufflations'?
qh: कौन सा फॉर्मूलेशन विशेष रूप से 'इनसफ्लेशन' (Insufflations) के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Medicated powders blown into body cavities | पाउडर
e: Insufflations are finely divided powders introduced into cavities like the nose or throat.

qe: Which mill is based on the principle of both 'Impact and Attrition'?
qh: कौन सी मिल 'इम्पैक्ट और एट्रिशन' दोनों के सिद्धांत पर आधारित है?
e: Ball mill uses both impact (falling balls) and attrition (grinding between balls) for size reduction.

qe: Which equipment works on the principle of 'Centrifugal Force' for size separation?
qh: साइज सेपरेशन के लिए कौन सा उपकरण 'सेंट्रीफ्यूगल फोर्स' के सिद्धांत पर कार्य करता है?
e: Cyclone separators use centrifugal force to separate solid particles from gases. The dust-laden air rotates inside a cone, and the heavier particles are thrown to the wall and fall to the bottom.

qe: What is the main disadvantage of 'Plastic' as a packaging material?
qh: पैकेजिंग सामग्री के रूप में 'प्लास्टिक' का मुख्य नुकसान क्या है?
o: Leaching and Sorption | लीचिंग और सोरप्शन
e: Plastics may interact with the formulation through leaching or absorbing the drug components.

qe: Which type of mixing equipment is used for 'Triple Roller Mill'?
qh: 'ट्रिपल रोलर मिल' का उपयोग किस प्रकार के मिश्रण के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Ointments and Creams | मलहम और क्रीम
e: Triple roller mill is used for the homogenization and mixing of semi-solids like ointments.

qe: The 'Fluidized Bed Dryer' (FBD) works on the principle of:
qh: 'फ्लूइडाइज्ड बेड ड्रायर' (FBD) किस सिद्धांत पर कार्य करता है?
e: FBD ensures rapid drying by suspending particles in a high-velocity hot air stream. The powder behaves like a boiling liquid, so drying is quick and uniform, and the product comes out free flowing.

qe: Which glass type is suitable for non-parenteral use only?
qh: कौन सा कांच केवल गैर-पैरेंट्रल (non-parenteral) उपयोग के लिए उपयुक्त है?
o: Type NP Glass | टाइप एनपी (NP) ग्लास
e: Type NP (Non-Parenteral) glass is used for oral or topical formulations. It is the lowest grade, used for oral and topical preparations where a little alkali release can be tolerated.

qe: Size reduction is also known as:
qh: 'साइज रिडक्शन' (Size reduction) को और किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: Comminution is the generic term for reducing the particle size of a solid substance. The solid is broken by grinding, crushing or cutting, which increases the surface area for dissolution and mixing.

qe: Which filter is used to remove bacteria and achieve sterilization?
qh: बैक्टीरिया को हटाने और स्टरलाइजेशन प्राप्त करने के लिए किस फिल्टर का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Membrane filters with specific pore sizes are used for sterile filtration of heat-sensitive liquids.

qe: The process of 'Maceration' is a type of:
qh: 'मैसरेशन' (Maceration) की प्रक्रिया एक प्रकार की है:
e: Maceration is a method of extraction where the drug is soaked in a menstruum. The drug is kept soaked in the solvent for several days with occasional stirring, and then the liquid is strained off.

qe: In packaging, 'Elastomeric closures' refers to:
qh: पैकेजिंग में, 'इलास्टोमेरिक क्लोजर' का तात्पर्य है:
e: Rubber is used as an elastomeric closure for vials and IV bottles. These rubber stoppers or caps are pierced by the needle and must seal themselves again; they can also shed particles into the product.

qe: Which dosage form is intended for placement into the rectum?
qh: कौन सा डोजेज फॉर्म मलाशय (Rectum) में रखने के लिए है?
e: Suppositories and pessaries are topical/systemic preparations for body cavities. They melt or dissolve in the rectum and give a local or a systemic effect, as with a paracetamol suppository for a child.

qe: Hard gelatin capsules are used to fill:
qh: हार्ड जिलेटिन कैप्सूल का उपयोग किसे भरने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Dry powders or granules | सूखा पाउडर या दाने
e: Hard gelatine capsules consist of two parts, a body and a cap, used for solids. They are filled with powders, granules, pellets or liquids, and they protect the drug and mask its taste.

qe: A 'Syrup' is a concentrated aqueous solution of:
qh: 'सिरप' किसका केंद्रित जलीय घोल है?
e: Syrups are sweet, viscous liquid oral preparations. It is nearly saturated with sucrose, which itself acts as a preservative, and it is used for cough and other liquid medicines.

qe: Which of these is a 'Biphasic' liquid dosage form?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा 'द्वि-चरणीय' (Biphasic) तरल डोजेज फॉर्म है?
e: Emulsions and suspensions consist of two phases (oil/water or solid/liquid). Such preparations must be shaken well before use, because the dispersed phase separates on standing.

qe: Sterile formulations include:
qh: स्टेराइल फॉर्मूलेशन (Sterile formulations) में शामिल हैं:
o: Injectables and Eye drops | इंजेक्शन और आई ड्रॉप
e: Sterile products must be free from any viable microorganisms. They include injections, eye drops, infusions and dialysis fluids, and they are prepared in a clean room.

qe: The term 'cGMP' stands for:
qh: 'cGMP' शब्द का अर्थ है:
o: Current Good Manufacturing Practices | वर्तमान अच्छी निर्माण प्रक्रियाएं
e: cGMP ensures that products are consistently produced and controlled to defined quality standards.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Novel Drug Delivery System' (NDDS)?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'नोवल ड्रग डिलीवरी सिस्टम' (NDDS) है?
e: NDDS aims to deliver drugs more effectively with fewer side effects. Liposomes, nanoparticles, microspheres and transdermal patches are common examples, and they carry the drug to the site of action.

qe: What is 'Validation' in pharmaceutical industry?
qh: फार्मास्युटिकल उद्योग में 'वैलिडेशन' (Validation) क्या है?
o: Documented evidence of consistency | निरंतरता का दस्तावेजी प्रमाण
e: Validation provides high degree of assurance that a process will consistently produce the desired result.

qe: Sera and Vaccines are examples of:
qh: सीरा और वैक्सीन किसके उदाहरण हैं?
e: These products are used to induce or provide immunity against diseases. They are produced in animals or by cell culture and are tested for potency, sterility and safety before release.

qe: BCG vaccine is used to provide protection against:
qh: BCG वैक्सीन का उपयोग किसके खिलाफ सुरक्षा प्रदान करने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: BCG is a live attenuated vaccine; it is not a toxoid. It is given at birth to protect the child against tuberculosis, mainly the severe forms.

qe: The process of 'Size Reduction' using a Hammer Mill works on the principle of:
qh: हैमर मिल का उपयोग करके 'साइज रिडक्शन' की प्रक्रिया किस सिद्धांत पर कार्य करती है?
e: Hammer mill reduces size by impact through rapidly moving hammers. A screen at the bottom decides the final particle size, and since heat is produced, heat-sensitive drugs are handled carefully.

qe: Which equipment is used for the process of 'Freeze Drying'?
qh: 'फ्रीज सुखाने' (Freeze Drying) की प्रक्रिया के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Freeze drying or Lyophilization is used for heat-sensitive materials like vaccines. The material is first frozen and then the ice is removed under vacuum, so the product keeps its shape and can be stored without a refrigerator.

qe: What is the primary function of 'Preservatives' in a formulation?
qh: एक फॉर्मूलेशन में 'प्रिजर्वेटिव' का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
o: To prevent microbial growth | माइक्रोबियल विकास को रोकना
e: Preservatives are added to multi-dose containers to maintain sterility. They stop the growth of bacteria, moulds and yeasts, and the preservative chosen must be safe, stable and compatible with the drug.

qe: 'Sieve No. 10' in the standard sieve series represents:
qh: मानक सीव श्रेणी में 'सीव नंबर 10' (Sieve No. 10) दर्शाता है:
e: Sieve numbers define the particle-size classification of powders. A lower sieve number means a coarser powder, and higher numbers give finer powders.

qe: Which of the following is an 'Organoleptic Agent'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'ऑर्गेनोलेप्टिक एजेंट' है?
o: Sweetening agent | मिठास देने वाला एजेंट
e: Organoleptic agents improve the appearance and taste of the medicine. Colouring and flavouring agents make the medicine pleasant to look at and easy to take, especially for children.

qe: Filtration using a 'Sintered Glass Filter' is best for:
qh: 'सिंटर्ड ग्लास फ़िल्टर' का उपयोग करके निस्पंदन सबसे अच्छा है:
o: Corrosive liquids and small volumes | संक्षारक तरल पदार्थ
e: Sintered glass filters are chemical resistant and do not shed fibers. Such filters are used for liquids that attack filter paper, and they are cleaned by reversing the flow.

qe: In extraction, the solvent used is often referred to as:
qh: निष्कर्षण (Extraction) में उपयोग किए जाने वाले विलायक को अक्सर कहा जाता है:
e: Menstruum is the solvent, while Marc is the exhausted drug residue. The choice of the menstruum depends on the nature of the drug, and the exhausted solid left behind is called the marc.

qe: In a prescription, the part that gives directions to the pharmacist about compounding and dispensing is called:
qh: एक प्रिस्क्रिप्शन में वह भाग जो फार्मासिस्ट को दवा तैयार करने और देने के निर्देश देता है, कहलाता है:
e: A prescription has four parts. The superscription carries the symbol Rx, the inscription gives the names and amounts of the ingredients, the subscription tells the pharmacist how to compound and dispense the medicine, and the signa tells the patient how to take it. Reading the subscription correctly prevents mistakes in strength, vehicle and number of doses dispensed.

qe: In the cold chain for vaccines, the recommended storage temperature is:
qh: टीकों की शीत-श्रृंखला (कोल्ड चेन) में भंडारण का अनुशंसित तापमान कितना है?
e: Most vaccines such as DPT, OPV (after thawing), hepatitis-B and tetanus toxoid are kept in the main compartment of the refrigerator between +2°C and +8°C. Freezing damages many of them, so they must never be placed in the freezer or near the ice pack compartment. A vaccine vial monitor and a temperature log help to detect any break in the cold chain.

qe: A child weighing 20 kg is prescribed a drug at 5 mg/kg/day in two divided doses. The amount for a single dose is:
qh: 20 किलो वजन के बच्चे को 5 मिलीग्राम/किलो/दिन की दर से दो बार दवा दी जानी है। एक खुराक की मात्रा क्या होगी?
e: The total daily dose is 5 mg multiplied by 20 kg, that is 100 mg. When this is divided into two doses, each single dose becomes 50 mg. Pediatric doses are always calculated on the basis of body weight or surface area, and the pharmacist must double-check the strength of the syrup or tablet before dispensing.

qe: The warning 'To be taken under medical supervision' must be printed on the label of drugs belonging to which schedule?
qh: 'चिकित्सकीय देखरेख में लेना है' चेतावनी किस शेड्यूल की दवाओं के लेबल पर छपी होती है?
e: Schedule H drugs are prescription-only medicines which can be sold only on the prescription of a registered medical practitioner, and the label must carry the warning in a box with a red border. Schedule X drugs need a special licence and a duplicate prescription, while Schedule F drugs carry the caution that they are to be used under medical supervision in certain conditions. Following the schedule prevents misuse and self-medication.

qe: In India, adverse drug reactions are collected and reported under which national programme?
qh: भारत में प्रतिकूल औषधि प्रतिक्रियाएँ किस राष्ट्रीय कार्यक्रम के अंतर्गत एकत्र की जाती हैं?
o: Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (PvPI) | भारत का फार्माकोविजिलेंस कार्यक्रम
e: The Pharmacovigilance Programme of India collects and analyses reports of adverse drug reactions from ADR monitoring centres across the country and sends them to the national coordination centre. The reports help in detecting new side effects, in changing warnings on labels and in withdrawing unsafe drugs. Every pharmacist must fill the suspected ADR form completely and send it without delay.

qe: In drug store management, VED analysis classifies items as:
qh: औषधि भंडार प्रबंधन में VED विश्लेषण वस्तुओं को किस प्रकार वर्गीकृत करता है?
o: Vital, Essential and Desirable | अत्यावश्यक, आवश्यक और वांछनीय
e: VED analysis groups drugs by how critical they are for patient care. Vital items such as adrenaline and oxygen must never be out of stock, essential items such as common antibiotics may be stocked at a moderate level, and desirable items such as tonics can be ordered in small quantity. It is used along with ABC analysis, which is based on the cost and consumption value of the items.

qe: In hospital pharmacy stock control, the FEFO principle means that drugs are issued:
qh: अस्पताल फार्मेसी के भंडार नियंत्रण में FEFO सिद्धांत का अर्थ है कि दवाइयाँ जारी की जाती हैं:
o: First Expiry First Out | पहले समाप्त होने वाली पहले बाहर
e: Under FEFO the batch whose expiry date is nearest is removed and used first, so that expired stock does not accumulate in the store. Stocks are also arranged on the shelf in the same order, and any item that has crossed its expiry date is separated and destroyed by the approved method. This simple practice saves money and protects patients from weak or harmful medicine.

qe: The quantitative determination of a drug substance by measuring the volume of a standard solution that reacts with it is called:
qh: मानक विलयन के आयतन को मापकर औषधि की मात्रात्मक जाँच करने की विधि कहलाती है:
e: In volumetric or titrimetric analysis a standard solution of known strength is added from a burette till the reaction is complete, and the volume used gives the amount of the drug present. An indicator marks the end point. It is simple, quick and cheap, which is why pharmacopoeias prescribe titration for many bulk drugs along with modern methods such as spectrophotometry and chromatography.
